Title: Chicken burrito bowls
Ingredients:
2 lb chicken breast
2 cup rice
1 can black beans
1 cup salsa
1 tbsp chili powder
1 tsp ground cumin
2 limes
1 cup shredded lettuce
Salt to taste
Steps:
Rinse the rice and cook it in 4 cups of salted water, covered, for 18 minutes; fluff and squeeze in the juice of 1 lime.
Toss the chicken with the chili powder, cumin, a big pinch of salt and a drizzle of oil.
Cook the chicken in a hot skillet or grill pan, 6 to 7 minutes per side, until it reaches 165 F inside. Rest 5 minutes, then slice.
Warm the black beans (with their liquid) in a small pot; drain before serving.
Build each bowl: rice, beans, chicken, lettuce and a big spoon of salsa.
Finish with a lime wedge and a pinch of salt.

Title: Chicken stir fry
Ingredients:
1 lb chicken breast
1 cup rice
2 tbsp soy sauce
1 head broccoli
1 red bell pepper
2 clove garlic
1 tbsp grated ginger
1 tbsp cornstarch
1 tbsp vegetable oil
Salt to taste
Steps:
Cook the rice in 2 cups of water, covered, for 18 minutes.
Slice the chicken thin and toss it with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt.
Cut the broccoli into small florets and slice the pepper.
Heat the oil in a wok or large skillet until shimmering. Stir-fry the chicken 4 to 5 minutes until browned and cooked through; move it to a plate.
Stir-fry the broccoli and pepper 3 minutes with a splash of water, then add the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Return the chicken, add the soy sauce, and toss for 1 minute until glossy. Serve over the rice.

Title: Turkey chili
Ingredients:
1½ lb ground turkey
1 can black beans
1 can diced tomatoes
1 can kidney beans
1 yellow onion
2 clove garlic
2 tbsp chili powder
1 tsp ground cumin
1 cup chicken broth
Steps:
Dice the onion and mince the garlic.
Brown the turkey in a large pot over medium-high heat, breaking it up, about 7 minutes.
Add the onion and cook 4 minutes until soft, then stir in the garlic, chili powder and cumin for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, both cans of beans (drained) and the broth.
Simmer uncovered 25 minutes, stirring now and then, until thick.
Taste for salt and serve hot.

Title: Sheet-pan lemon herb chicken and potatoes
Ingredients:
2 lb chicken thighs, boneless skinless
1½ lb baby potatoes
1 lb green beans
2 lemons
3 tbsp olive oil
4 clove garlic
1 tbsp dried oregano
1 tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper
Steps:
Heat the oven to 425 F.
Halve the potatoes and toss them on a sheet pan with 1 tablespoon oil and half the salt. Roast 15 minutes.
Whisk the remaining oil, the juice of 1 lemon, minced garlic, oregano, the rest of the salt and the pepper.
Toss the chicken and green beans in the lemon mixture.
Push the potatoes aside, add the chicken and green beans, and slice the second lemon over the top.
Roast 20 to 25 minutes, until the chicken reaches 165 F and the potatoes are golden.
Spoon the pan juices over everything before serving.

Title: Beef and broccoli
Ingredients:
1½ lb flank steak
2 head broccoli
1 cup rice
⅓ cup soy sauce
2 tbsp brown sugar
1 tbsp cornstarch
3 clove garlic
1 tbsp grated ginger
1 tbsp vegetable oil
Steps:
Cook the rice in 2 cups of water, covered, 18 minutes.
Slice the steak very thin across the grain and toss with half the cornstarch.
Whisk the soy sauce, brown sugar, remaining cornstarch and ½ cup water for the sauce.
Steam the broccoli florets in a covered skillet with ¼ cup water for 3 minutes; drain and set aside.
Heat the oil in the skillet until very hot and sear the beef in two batches, 2 minutes each.
Add the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds, pour in the sauce, and simmer 1 minute until thick.
Toss in the broccoli and serve over rice.

Title: Shrimp tacos with lime slaw
Ingredients:
1½ lb shrimp, peeled
12 corn tortillas
3 cup shredded cabbage
½ cup plain Greek yogurt
2 limes
1 tbsp chili powder
1 tsp garlic powder
1 avocado
½ bunch cilantro
1 tbsp olive oil
Steps:
Toss the cabbage with the yogurt, the juice of 1 lime, a pinch of salt and chopped cilantro. Chill while you cook.
Pat the shrimp dry and toss with the chili powder, garlic powder, oil and a pinch of salt.
Cook the shrimp in a hot skillet 2 minutes per side until pink and curled.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan 30 seconds per side, stacking them under a towel.
Slice the avocado.
Fill each tortilla with shrimp, slaw and avocado, and squeeze lime over the top.

Title: Greek chicken souvlaki bowls
Ingredients:
2 lb chicken breast
1 cup rice
1 cup plain Greek yogurt
1 cucumber
2 tomatoes
½ red onion
2 lemons
2 tbsp olive oil
1 tbsp dried oregano
3 clove garlic
½ cup crumbled feta
Steps:
Cut the chicken into 1-inch cubes and marinate 15 minutes with oil, the juice of 1 lemon, oregano, 2 cloves garlic and salt.
Cook the rice in 2 cups of water, covered, 18 minutes.
Grate half the cucumber, squeeze out the water, and stir it into the yogurt with the last garlic clove and a pinch of salt for tzatziki.
Dice the rest of the cucumber, the tomatoes and the onion for a quick salad.
Cook the chicken in a hot skillet or on skewers, 8 to 10 minutes, turning, until browned and 165 F inside.
Fill bowls with rice, chicken and salad; top with tzatziki, feta and a lemon wedge.

Title: Salmon with roasted asparagus and rice
Ingredients:
4 salmon fillets, 6 oz each
1 cup rice
2 bunch asparagus
2 tbsp olive oil
2 lemons
2 clove garlic
1 tbsp dried dill
Salt to taste
Steps:
Heat the oven to 400 F and cook the rice in 2 cups of water, covered, 18 minutes.
Snap the woody ends off the asparagus and toss the spears with 1 tablespoon oil and salt on a sheet pan.
Rub the salmon with the remaining oil, minced garlic, dill, salt and pepper; set it on the pan beside the asparagus.
Lay lemon slices over the salmon.
Roast 12 to 15 minutes, until the salmon flakes easily.
Serve with the rice and a squeeze of lemon.

Title: Turkey meatballs marinara over spaghetti
Ingredients:
1½ lb ground turkey
12 oz spaghetti
1 jar marinara sauce
1 egg
½ cup breadcrumbs
⅓ cup grated parmesan
3 clove garlic
1 tsp Italian seasoning
½ bunch parsley
Steps:
Heat the oven to 400 F and line a sheet pan with parchment.
Mix the turkey, egg, breadcrumbs, half the parmesan, minced garlic, Italian seasoning, chopped parsley and a pinch of salt. Roll into 20 meatballs.
Bake the meatballs 18 minutes until browned and 165 F inside.
Meanwhile, cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente; drain.
Warm the marinara in a large pan, add the meatballs, and simmer 5 minutes.
Serve the meatballs and sauce over spaghetti with the remaining parmesan.

Title: Chicken fajitas
Ingredients:
2 lb chicken breast
3 bell peppers
1 yellow onion
8 flour tortillas
2 limes
2 tbsp olive oil
1 tbsp chili powder
1 tsp ground cumin
1 tsp smoked paprika
½ cup salsa
Steps:
Slice the chicken into strips and the peppers and onion into strips.
Toss the chicken with half the oil, the spices, the juice of 1 lime and salt.
Cook the chicken in a very hot cast-iron skillet 6 to 7 minutes until browned and cooked through; set aside.
Add the remaining oil, then the peppers and onion, and cook 6 minutes until charred at the edges but still crisp.
Return the chicken and toss together.
Warm the tortillas and serve with salsa and lime wedges.

Title: Teriyaki salmon rice bowls
Ingredients:
4 salmon fillets, 6 oz each
1½ cup rice
⅓ cup soy sauce
2 tbsp honey
1 tbsp rice vinegar
1 tbsp grated ginger
2 clove garlic
1 cucumber
1 cup shelled edamame
1 tbsp sesame seeds
Steps:
Cook the rice in 3 cups of water, covered, 18 minutes.
Simmer the soy sauce, honey, vinegar, ginger and garlic in a small pan 3 minutes until slightly thick.
Sear the salmon skin-side up in a hot oiled skillet 4 minutes, flip, and cook 3 to 4 minutes more.
Brush half the sauce over the salmon in the pan.
Warm the edamame in the microwave and slice the cucumber.
Build bowls of rice, salmon, cucumber and edamame; drizzle the rest of the sauce and sprinkle sesame seeds.

Title: Lean beef tacos
Ingredients:
1½ lb lean ground beef
12 corn tortillas
1 packet taco seasoning
2 cup shredded lettuce
2 tomatoes
1 cup shredded cheddar
½ cup salsa
½ cup plain Greek yogurt
Steps:
Brown the beef in a skillet over medium-high heat, 7 minutes, breaking it up; drain any fat.
Stir in the taco seasoning and ⅔ cup water and simmer 5 minutes until saucy.
Dice the tomatoes.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan.
Fill the tortillas with beef, lettuce, tomato and cheese.
Top with salsa and a spoon of Greek yogurt in place of sour cream.

Title: Chicken tikka masala
Ingredients:
2 lb chicken breast
1 cup basmati rice
1 cup plain Greek yogurt
1 can crushed tomatoes
½ cup light coconut milk
1 yellow onion
4 clove garlic
1 tbsp grated ginger
2 tbsp garam masala
1 tsp turmeric
1 tbsp olive oil
Steps:
Cube the chicken and marinate with ½ cup yogurt, 1 tablespoon garam masala, the turmeric and salt for at least 15 minutes.
Cook the rice in 2 cups of water, covered, 15 minutes.
Sear the chicken in hot oil 5 minutes until browned on the edges; set aside.
Cook the diced onion 5 minutes, then the garlic, ginger and remaining garam masala for 1 minute.
Add the crushed tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in the coconut milk and the remaining yogurt off the heat, return the chicken, and simmer gently 5 minutes.
Serve over the rice.

Title: Pork tenderloin with sweet potatoes and green beans
Ingredients:
2 pork tenderloins, about 1 lb each
2 sweet potatoes
1 lb green beans
2 tbsp olive oil
2 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 tbsp honey
1 tsp dried thyme
Salt to taste
Steps:
Heat the oven to 425 F.
Cube the sweet potatoes, toss with 1 tablespoon oil and salt, and roast 15 minutes.
Rub the pork with salt, pepper and thyme, and brown it on all sides in the remaining oil in an oven-safe skillet, 6 minutes.
Mix the mustard and honey and brush it over the pork.
Add the green beans to the potato pan and move the skillet with the pork into the oven.
Roast 15 to 18 minutes, until the pork reaches 145 F. Rest it 5 minutes, then slice.
Serve with the potatoes and green beans.

Title: Korean beef bulgogi bowls
Ingredients:
1½ lb thin-sliced sirloin
1½ cup rice
⅓ cup soy sauce
2 tbsp brown sugar
1 tbsp sesame oil
1 Asian pear or apple
4 clove garlic
1 tbsp grated ginger
1 bunch green onions
2 carrots
1 cucumber
Steps:
Grate the pear and mix it with the soy sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil, garlic and ginger. Marinate the beef 20 minutes.
Cook the rice in 3 cups of water, covered, 18 minutes.
Cut the carrots and cucumber into matchsticks.
Cook the beef in a very hot skillet in batches, 2 to 3 minutes, until caramelized.
Slice the green onions.
Serve the beef over rice with the vegetables and green onions.

Title: Chicken Caesar wraps
Ingredients:
1½ lb chicken breast
4 large whole wheat tortillas
2 head romaine
½ cup light Caesar dressing
⅓ cup grated parmesan
1 lemon
1 tsp garlic powder
Steps:
Season the chicken with garlic powder, salt and pepper.
Cook in a hot oiled skillet 6 to 7 minutes per side until 165 F. Rest 5 minutes and slice.
Chop the romaine and toss with the dressing, parmesan and a squeeze of lemon.
Lay out the tortillas and fill each with salad and chicken.
Roll tightly, folding in the sides, and cut in half.

Title: Shrimp fried rice
Ingredients:
1 lb shrimp, peeled
3 cup cooked rice, cold
3 eggs
1 cup frozen peas and carrots
1 bunch green onions
3 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp sesame oil
2 clove garlic
1 tbsp vegetable oil
Steps:
Use day-old rice; break up any clumps with your fingers.
Scramble the eggs in a hot oiled wok, then move them to a plate.
Cook the shrimp 2 minutes per side until pink; set aside with the eggs.
Stir-fry the peas and carrots and garlic 2 minutes.
Add the rice and press it against the hot pan for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring now and then, until it crackles.
Add the soy sauce, sesame oil, shrimp, eggs and sliced green onions; toss 1 minute and serve.

Title: Black bean and sweet potato enchiladas
Ingredients:
2 sweet potatoes
2 can black beans
8 corn tortillas
1 can red enchilada sauce
1 cup shredded Mexican cheese
1 tsp ground cumin
1 tsp chili powder
½ bunch cilantro
½ cup plain Greek yogurt
Steps:
Heat the oven to 400 F.
Peel and dice the sweet potatoes and microwave them with a splash of water, covered, 8 minutes until tender.
Mash half the sweet potato with the beans, cumin, chili powder and salt; fold in the rest of the cubes.
Spread ½ cup sauce in a baking dish. Fill and roll the tortillas and set them seam-side down.
Pour over the remaining sauce and sprinkle the cheese.
Bake 20 minutes until bubbling.
Top with cilantro and Greek yogurt.

Title: Thai basil chicken
Ingredients:
1½ lb ground chicken
1½ cup jasmine rice
4 clove garlic
2 red chilies
1 bunch Thai basil
2 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp oyster sauce
1 tbsp fish sauce
1 tsp sugar
1 tbsp vegetable oil
Steps:
Cook the rice in 3 cups of water, covered, 15 minutes.
Mix the soy sauce, oyster sauce, fish sauce, sugar and 2 tablespoons water.
Pound or finely chop the garlic and chilies.
Fry the garlic and chilies in hot oil 30 seconds, then add the chicken and cook 6 minutes, breaking it up, until browned.
Pour in the sauce and toss until it coats the chicken.
Turn off the heat and fold in the basil leaves until wilted. Serve over rice.

Title: Baked cod with lemon capers and orzo
Ingredients:
4 cod fillets, 6 oz each
1 cup orzo
2 lemons
2 tbsp capers
2 tbsp olive oil
2 clove garlic
1 pint cherry tomatoes
2 cup baby spinach
½ bunch parsley
Steps:
Heat the oven to 400 F.
Set the cod and halved tomatoes in a baking dish. Drizzle with oil, garlic, salt, pepper and the juice of 1 lemon. Scatter the capers.
Bake 12 to 15 minutes until the fish flakes.
Meanwhile, boil the orzo in salted water 8 minutes; drain.
Toss the orzo with the spinach (it wilts from the heat), the zest of the second lemon and chopped parsley.
Serve the cod and tomatoes over the orzo with the pan juices.

Title: Chicken parmesan (lightened)
Ingredients:
2 lb chicken breast
8 oz spaghetti
1 jar marinara sauce
1 cup panko breadcrumbs
½ cup grated parmesan
1 cup shredded part-skim mozzarella
2 eggs
1 tsp Italian seasoning
Steps:
Heat the oven to 425 F and set a rack on a sheet pan.
Slice the chicken breasts in half horizontally into thin cutlets.
Dip each cutlet in beaten egg, then in the panko mixed with half the parmesan and the Italian seasoning.
Bake on the rack 15 minutes until golden.
Spoon marinara over each cutlet, top with mozzarella and the rest of the parmesan, and bake 5 more minutes until melted.
Meanwhile, cook the spaghetti in salted water; toss with the remaining warm marinara and serve alongside.

Title: Beef and bean burritos
Ingredients:
1 lb lean ground beef
1 can refried beans
1 cup rice
8 flour tortillas
1 cup shredded cheddar
1 cup salsa
1 packet taco seasoning
Steps:
Cook the rice in 2 cups of water, covered, 18 minutes.
Brown the beef 7 minutes; drain and stir in the taco seasoning with ½ cup water. Simmer 3 minutes.
Warm the refried beans.
Warm the tortillas so they fold without cracking.
Spread beans down each tortilla, then add rice, beef, salsa and cheese.
Fold in the sides and roll. Toast seam-side down in a dry pan 1 minute per side.

Title: Egg roll in a bowl
Ingredients:
1½ lb lean ground pork
1 bag coleslaw mix
3 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp sesame oil
1 tbsp rice vinegar
3 clove garlic
1 tbsp grated ginger
1 bunch green onions
1 tbsp sriracha
Steps:
Brown the pork in a large skillet 7 minutes, breaking it up.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook 1 minute.
Add the coleslaw mix and stir-fry 4 to 5 minutes until just tender.
Stir in the soy sauce, vinegar and sesame oil.
Top with sliced green onions and a drizzle of sriracha.

Title: Chicken noodle soup
Ingredients:
1½ lb chicken breast
8 oz egg noodles
8 cup chicken broth
3 carrots
3 stalk celery
1 yellow onion
2 clove garlic
1 tsp dried thyme
½ bunch parsley
Steps:
Dice the onion, carrots and celery.
Soften them in a splash of oil in a large pot 6 minutes, then add the garlic and thyme for 1 minute.
Add the broth and whole chicken breasts. Simmer 15 minutes until the chicken is cooked.
Lift out the chicken and shred it with two forks.
Add the noodles to the pot and cook 7 minutes.
Return the chicken, season with salt and pepper, and finish with chopped parsley.

Title: Lentil and sausage soup
Ingredients:
12 oz turkey Italian sausage
1½ cup brown lentils
1 can diced tomatoes
6 cup chicken broth
1 yellow onion
2 carrots
2 stalk celery
3 cup kale
2 clove garlic
Steps:
Brown the sausage, removed from its casing, in a large pot 6 minutes.
Add the diced onion, carrots and celery and cook 5 minutes.
Stir in the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the rinsed lentils, tomatoes and broth. Simmer covered 25 minutes until the lentils are tender.
Stir in the chopped kale and cook 3 minutes.
Season and serve.

Title: Greek turkey burgers with tzatziki
Ingredients:
1½ lb ground turkey
4 whole wheat buns
½ cup crumbled feta
2 cup baby spinach
1 cup plain Greek yogurt
1 cucumber
2 clove garlic
1 tsp dried oregano
1 tomato
Steps:
Chop 1 cup of the spinach finely and mix it with the turkey, feta, oregano, 1 garlic clove and salt. Shape 4 patties.
Grate half the cucumber, squeeze it dry, and stir it into the yogurt with the remaining garlic for tzatziki.
Cook the patties in a hot oiled skillet or grill 5 to 6 minutes per side until 165 F.
Toast the buns.
Build burgers with spinach, tomato slices and a big spoon of tzatziki.

Title: BBQ chicken with corn and slaw
Ingredients:
2 lb chicken breast
4 ear corn
½ cup BBQ sauce
3 cup coleslaw mix
⅓ cup plain Greek yogurt
1 tbsp apple cider vinegar
1 tsp smoked paprika
1 tsp garlic powder
Steps:
Rub the chicken with paprika, garlic powder and salt.
Grill or pan-sear the chicken 6 minutes per side, brushing with BBQ sauce in the last few minutes, until 165 F.
Grill or boil the corn 6 to 8 minutes.
Stir the yogurt, vinegar and a pinch of salt and sugar into the coleslaw mix.
Slice the chicken and serve with corn and slaw, with extra BBQ sauce on the side.

Title: Shrimp and grits
Ingredients:
1½ lb shrimp, peeled
1 cup quick grits
2 cup milk
½ cup shredded sharp cheddar
4 slice turkey bacon
1 green bell pepper
1 bunch green onions
2 clove garlic
1 tsp Cajun seasoning
1 lemon
Steps:
Bring the milk and 2 cups of water to a simmer, whisk in the grits, and cook 5 to 7 minutes until thick. Stir in the cheese and salt.
Cook the turkey bacon in a skillet until crisp; chop it.
In the same pan, cook the diced pepper 4 minutes.
Toss the shrimp with the Cajun seasoning and cook with the garlic 2 minutes per side until pink.
Squeeze in the lemon and add the bacon and sliced green onions.
Spoon the shrimp over the grits.

Title: Cajun chicken pasta
Ingredients:
1½ lb chicken breast
12 oz penne
1 red bell pepper
1 green bell pepper
1 cup half-and-half
½ cup grated parmesan
2 tbsp Cajun seasoning
3 clove garlic
1 tbsp olive oil
Steps:
Cook the penne in salted water until al dente; save 1 cup of the pasta water and drain.
Slice the chicken into strips and toss with 1 tablespoon Cajun seasoning.
Sear the chicken in the oil 6 minutes until cooked through; set aside.
Cook the sliced peppers 4 minutes, then the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the half-and-half, remaining Cajun seasoning and parmesan; simmer 2 minutes.
Toss in the pasta and chicken, loosening with pasta water as needed.

Title: Red beans and rice with andouille
Ingredients:
12 oz chicken andouille sausage
2 can red kidney beans
1½ cup rice
1 yellow onion
1 green bell pepper
2 stalk celery
3 clove garlic
2 tsp Cajun seasoning
2 cup chicken broth
2 bay leaf
Steps:
Cook the rice in 3 cups of water, covered, 18 minutes.
Slice the sausage into coins and brown it in a pot 5 minutes.
Add the diced onion, pepper and celery and cook 6 minutes.
Stir in the garlic and Cajun seasoning for 1 minute.
Add the beans with their liquid, the broth and bay leaves. Simmer 20 minutes, mashing some beans against the pot to thicken.
Remove the bay leaves and serve over the rice.

Title: Chicken shawarma plates
Ingredients:
2 lb chicken thighs, boneless skinless
1 cup rice
1 cup plain Greek yogurt
2 lemons
3 tbsp olive oil
4 clove garlic
2 tsp ground cumin
2 tsp smoked paprika
1 tsp ground cinnamon
1 cucumber
2 tomatoes
½ red onion
Steps:
Whisk 2 tablespoons oil, the juice of 1 lemon, 3 cloves garlic, cumin, paprika, cinnamon and salt. Coat the chicken and marinate 20 minutes.
Cook the rice in 2 cups of water, covered, 18 minutes.
Stir the remaining garlic and a squeeze of lemon into the yogurt for a garlic sauce.
Cook the chicken in a hot skillet or under the broiler 5 to 6 minutes per side until charred and 165 F. Rest, then slice thin.
Dice the cucumber, tomatoes and onion and toss with the last of the oil and lemon.
Plate rice, chicken and salad, and spoon over the garlic sauce.

Title: Falafel bowls with hummus
Ingredients:
2 can chickpeas
1 small yellow onion
3 clove garlic
1 bunch parsley
2 tsp ground cumin
3 tbsp flour
1 cup quinoa
1 cup hummus
1 cucumber
1 pint cherry tomatoes
2 tbsp olive oil
1 lemon
Steps:
Heat the oven to 400 F and oil a sheet pan.
Pulse 1 can of drained chickpeas with the onion, garlic, parsley, cumin, flour and salt into a coarse paste. Roll into 16 small patties.
Bake the falafel 25 minutes, flipping halfway, until crisp.
Cook the quinoa in 2 cups of water, covered, 15 minutes.
Toss the second can of chickpeas, diced cucumber and halved tomatoes with lemon juice and salt.
Build bowls with quinoa, falafel, salad and a big scoop of hummus.

Title: Steak with chimichurri and roasted potatoes
Ingredients:
2 lb sirloin steak
1½ lb baby potatoes
1 bunch parsley
3 clove garlic
3 tbsp red wine vinegar
4 tbsp olive oil
1 tsp red pepper flakes
1 tsp dried oregano
1 lb green beans
Steps:
Heat the oven to 425 F. Halve the potatoes, toss with 1 tablespoon oil and salt, and roast 30 minutes.
Chop the parsley and garlic finely and stir with the vinegar, 3 tablespoons oil, pepper flakes, oregano and salt for chimichurri.
Pat the steak dry and season well with salt and pepper.
Sear in a very hot cast-iron pan 4 to 5 minutes per side for medium. Rest 8 minutes.
Steam the green beans 5 minutes.
Slice the steak across the grain and spoon chimichurri over everything.

Title: Chicken pho
Ingredients:
1½ lb chicken breast
8 oz rice noodles
8 cup chicken broth
1 yellow onion
3 inch piece fresh ginger
2 star anise
1 cinnamon stick
2 tbsp fish sauce
2 cup bean sprouts
1 bunch Thai basil
2 limes
1 jalapeno
Steps:
Halve the onion and slice the ginger; char them in a dry pot until blackened in spots, 5 minutes.
Add the broth, star anise, cinnamon and chicken. Simmer gently 20 minutes.
Remove the chicken and shred or slice it. Strain the broth and stir in the fish sauce.
Soak or cook the rice noodles per the package; divide into bowls.
Top with chicken and ladle over the hot broth.
Serve with bean sprouts, basil, sliced jalapeno and lime wedges.

Title: Banh mi chicken bowls
Ingredients:
1½ lb chicken thighs, boneless skinless
1½ cup jasmine rice
2 carrots
1 daikon radish or 6 radishes
½ cup rice vinegar
2 tbsp sugar
2 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp fish sauce
2 clove garlic
1 cucumber
½ bunch cilantro
2 tbsp light mayo
1 tbsp sriracha
Steps:
Cut the carrots and radish into matchsticks and cover with the vinegar, 1 tablespoon sugar and a pinch of salt. Pickle 20 minutes.
Marinate the chicken with soy sauce, fish sauce, garlic and the remaining sugar 15 minutes.
Cook the rice in 3 cups of water, covered, 15 minutes.
Cook the chicken in a hot skillet 5 to 6 minutes per side until caramelized and 165 F. Slice.
Stir the mayo and sriracha together.
Build bowls with rice, chicken, drained pickles, cucumber and cilantro; drizzle the spicy mayo.

Title: Tuna poke bowls
Ingredients:
1½ lb sushi-grade tuna
1½ cup sushi rice
3 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp sesame oil
1 tbsp rice vinegar
1 avocado
1 cucumber
1 cup shelled edamame
1 bunch green onions
1 tbsp sesame seeds
Steps:
Rinse the rice until the water runs clear and cook it in 2 cups of water, covered, 15 minutes. Season with the rice vinegar and a pinch of sugar and salt.
Cut the tuna into ¾-inch cubes and toss with the soy sauce, sesame oil and sliced green onions. Chill 10 minutes.
Dice the cucumber and avocado and thaw the edamame.
Build bowls of rice, tuna, cucumber, avocado and edamame.
Finish with sesame seeds.

Title: Kalua-style pulled pork with rice
Ingredients:
3 lb pork shoulder
1½ cup rice
1 tbsp liquid smoke
1 tbsp coarse salt
1 head green cabbage
1 can pineapple chunks
1 tbsp soy sauce
Steps:
Rub the pork with the salt and liquid smoke.
Slow-cook on low 8 to 10 hours (or pressure-cook 75 minutes) with ½ cup water until it falls apart.
Shred the pork, discarding fat, and toss it with some of the cooking juices.
Cook the rice in 3 cups of water, covered, 18 minutes.
Cut the cabbage into wedges and stir it into the juices in the cooker for the last 20 minutes, or steam it 8 minutes.
Serve pork over rice with cabbage and pineapple, splashed with soy sauce.

Title: Chicken adobo
Ingredients:
2 lb chicken thighs, boneless skinless
1½ cup rice
½ cup soy sauce
½ cup white vinegar
8 clove garlic
3 bay leaf
1 tsp black peppercorns
1 tbsp brown sugar
1 bunch green onions
Steps:
Smash the garlic. Combine the soy sauce, vinegar, garlic, bay leaves, peppercorns and brown sugar in a pot.
Add the chicken and marinate 15 minutes, or longer if you have time.
Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer 25 minutes, turning the chicken once.
Cook the rice in 3 cups of water, covered, 18 minutes.
Uncover the adobo and simmer 8 minutes more until the sauce reduces and the chicken is glossy.
Serve over rice with the sauce and sliced green onions.

Title: Butter chicken
Ingredients:
2 lb chicken breast
1 cup basmati rice
1 can tomato sauce
½ cup half-and-half
½ cup plain Greek yogurt
2 tbsp butter
1 yellow onion
4 clove garlic
1 tbsp grated ginger
2 tsp garam masala
1 tsp chili powder
1 tsp ground cumin
Steps:
Cube the chicken and marinate with the yogurt, 1 teaspoon garam masala, chili powder and salt for 15 minutes.
Cook the rice in 2 cups of water, covered, 15 minutes.
Melt the butter and cook the diced onion 6 minutes until golden.
Add the garlic, ginger, cumin and remaining garam masala for 1 minute.
Add the tomato sauce and simmer 10 minutes, then add the chicken and simmer 10 minutes more until cooked.
Stir in the half-and-half and warm through. Serve over rice.

Title: Chana masala
Ingredients:
2 can chickpeas
1 can diced tomatoes
1 cup basmati rice
1 yellow onion
4 clove garlic
1 tbsp grated ginger
1 jalapeno
2 tsp garam masala
1 tsp ground cumin
1 tsp turmeric
2 tbsp olive oil
½ bunch cilantro
1 lemon
Steps:
Cook the rice in 2 cups of water, covered, 15 minutes.
Cook the diced onion in the oil 8 minutes until deep golden.
Add the garlic, ginger, minced jalapeno and spices; stir 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and simmer 5 minutes, then the drained chickpeas and ½ cup water.
Simmer 15 minutes, mashing a few chickpeas to thicken.
Finish with lemon juice and cilantro and serve over rice.

Title: Dal with spinach
Ingredients:
1½ cup red lentils
1 cup basmati rice
1 can diced tomatoes
1 yellow onion
3 clove garlic
1 tbsp grated ginger
1 tsp turmeric
2 tsp ground cumin
1 tsp mustard seeds
4 cup baby spinach
1 tbsp butter
1 lemon
Steps:
Rinse the lentils and simmer them in 4 cups of water with the turmeric 20 minutes until soft.
Cook the rice in 2 cups of water, covered, 15 minutes.
Melt the butter, sizzle the mustard seeds 30 seconds, then cook the diced onion 6 minutes.
Add the garlic, ginger and cumin for 1 minute, then the tomatoes for 5 minutes.
Stir the tomato mixture into the lentils with the spinach until wilted.
Season with salt and lemon and serve over rice.

Title: Turkey taco skillet
Ingredients:
1½ lb ground turkey
1 can black beans
1 can fire-roasted tomatoes
1 cup frozen corn
1 cup instant brown rice
1 packet taco seasoning
1 cup shredded Mexican cheese
1 bunch green onions
Steps:
Brown the turkey in a large skillet 7 minutes.
Stir in the taco seasoning, tomatoes, drained beans, corn, rice and 1¼ cups water.
Bring to a boil, cover, and simmer 10 minutes until the rice is tender.
Scatter the cheese over the top, cover, and let it melt 2 minutes.
Top with sliced green onions and serve from the skillet.

Title: Chicken enchilada casserole
Ingredients:
1½ lb rotisserie chicken meat, shredded
10 corn tortillas
1 can red enchilada sauce
1 can black beans
1 cup frozen corn
1½ cup shredded Mexican cheese
½ cup plain Greek yogurt
1 bunch green onions
Steps:
Heat the oven to 375 F.
Mix the chicken, drained beans, corn, half the sauce and half the cheese.
Spread a little sauce in a 9x13 dish. Layer tortillas, half the filling, more tortillas and the rest of the filling.
Pour the remaining sauce over the top and sprinkle with the rest of the cheese.
Cover with foil and bake 20 minutes, then uncover and bake 10 more.
Rest 5 minutes and serve with Greek yogurt and green onions.

Title: Carne asada bowls
Ingredients:
2 lb flank steak
1½ cup rice
3 limes
1 orange
4 clove garlic
1 jalapeno
1 tbsp ground cumin
2 tbsp olive oil
1 can pinto beans
1 cup pico de gallo
1 avocado
Steps:
Blend the juice of 2 limes and the orange with the garlic, jalapeno, cumin, oil and salt. Marinate the steak 30 minutes.
Cook the rice in 3 cups of water, covered, 18 minutes; stir in the juice of the last lime.
Grill or sear the steak over high heat 4 to 5 minutes per side. Rest 8 minutes and slice thin across the grain.
Warm the pinto beans.
Build bowls with rice, beans, steak, pico de gallo and sliced avocado.

Title: Chicken tortilla soup
Ingredients:
1½ lb chicken breast
6 cup chicken broth
1 can fire-roasted tomatoes
1 can black beans
1 cup frozen corn
1 yellow onion
3 clove garlic
2 tsp chili powder
1 tsp ground cumin
6 corn tortillas
1 avocado
2 limes
Steps:
Cook the diced onion in a splash of oil 5 minutes, then the garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Add the broth, tomatoes and whole chicken breasts. Simmer 20 minutes.
Shred the chicken and return it with the drained beans and corn; simmer 5 minutes.
Cut the tortillas into strips and bake at 400 F for 8 minutes until crisp.
Season the soup with lime juice and salt.
Serve topped with tortilla strips and diced avocado.

Title: Pozole rojo
Ingredients:
2 lb pork tenderloin
2 can hominy
8 cup chicken broth
4 dried guajillo chilies
1 yellow onion
4 clove garlic
1 tsp dried oregano
1 tsp ground cumin
2 cup shredded cabbage
6 radishes
2 limes
Steps:
Toast the chilies in a dry pan 30 seconds per side, then soak them in hot water 15 minutes.
Blend the chilies with half the onion, the garlic, oregano, cumin and 1 cup of broth until smooth.
Cut the pork into 1-inch cubes and brown it in a large pot in batches.
Strain the chili sauce into the pot, add the rest of the broth and the drained hominy, and simmer 30 minutes.
Season with salt.
Serve with cabbage, sliced radishes, diced onion and lime wedges.

Title: Spaghetti bolognese
Ingredients:
1½ lb lean ground beef
12 oz spaghetti
1 can crushed tomatoes
2 tbsp tomato paste
1 yellow onion
2 carrots
2 stalk celery
3 clove garlic
½ cup milk
1 tsp dried oregano
⅓ cup grated parmesan
Steps:
Finely dice the onion, carrots and celery and soften them in a splash of oil 8 minutes.
Add the beef and brown it 8 minutes, breaking it up.
Stir in the garlic and tomato paste for 1 minute, then the crushed tomatoes, oregano and milk.
Simmer gently 30 minutes, stirring now and then.
Cook the spaghetti in salted water until al dente; drain.
Toss the pasta with the sauce and top with parmesan.

Title: Chicken pesto pasta with peas
Ingredients:
1½ lb chicken breast
12 oz penne
⅓ cup basil pesto
1 cup frozen peas
1 pint cherry tomatoes
⅓ cup grated parmesan
1 lemon
Steps:
Cook the penne in salted water; add the peas for the last 2 minutes. Save ½ cup of the pasta water and drain.
Season the chicken and cook it in a hot oiled skillet 6 to 7 minutes per side. Rest and slice.
Halve the tomatoes.
Toss the pasta and peas with the pesto, a splash of pasta water and the lemon zest.
Fold in the chicken and tomatoes and top with parmesan.

Title: Shrimp scampi with zucchini and linguine
Ingredients:
1½ lb shrimp, peeled
8 oz linguine
2 zucchini
4 clove garlic
2 tbsp butter
1 tbsp olive oil
½ cup chicken broth
1 lemon
½ tsp red pepper flakes
½ bunch parsley
Steps:
Cook the linguine in salted water until al dente; drain.
Cut the zucchini into thin noodles or half-moons.
Heat the butter and oil and cook the garlic and pepper flakes 1 minute.
Add the shrimp and cook 2 minutes per side until pink.
Add the broth, the juice of the lemon and the zucchini; simmer 2 minutes.
Toss in the linguine and chopped parsley and serve.

Title: Baked ziti with lean beef
Ingredients:
1 lb lean ground beef
12 oz ziti
1 jar marinara sauce
1 cup part-skim ricotta
1½ cup shredded part-skim mozzarella
⅓ cup grated parmesan
2 cup baby spinach
2 clove garlic
Steps:
Heat the oven to 375 F.
Cook the ziti 2 minutes short of al dente; drain.
Brown the beef with the garlic 7 minutes, drain, and stir in the marinara.
Mix the pasta with the sauce, the spinach and spoonfuls of ricotta.
Spread in a 9x13 dish and top with the mozzarella and parmesan.
Bake 25 minutes until bubbling and golden. Rest 5 minutes before serving.

Title: Minestrone with white beans
Ingredients:
2 can cannellini beans
1 can diced tomatoes
6 cup vegetable broth
1 cup small pasta
2 zucchini
2 carrots
2 stalk celery
1 yellow onion
3 clove garlic
3 cup kale
1 tsp Italian seasoning
⅓ cup grated parmesan
Steps:
Dice the onion, carrots and celery and soften them in a splash of oil 6 minutes.
Add the garlic and Italian seasoning for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, broth and 1 can of beans; simmer 15 minutes.
Add the diced zucchini, the second can of beans and the pasta; simmer 10 minutes until the pasta is tender.
Stir in the chopped kale for 2 minutes.
Season and serve with parmesan.

Title: Margherita flatbread with chicken
Ingredients:
4 naan flatbreads
1 lb cooked chicken breast, sliced
1 cup marinara sauce
1½ cup shredded part-skim mozzarella
2 tomatoes
1 bunch basil
1 tbsp olive oil
Steps:
Heat the oven to 450 F.
Lay the flatbreads on sheet pans and spread each with marinara.
Top with the chicken, sliced tomatoes and mozzarella.
Bake 8 to 10 minutes until the cheese bubbles and the edges are crisp.
Scatter fresh basil and drizzle a little olive oil before slicing.

Title: Lemon garlic salmon with quinoa
Ingredients:
4 salmon fillets, 6 oz each
1 cup quinoa
2 lemons
4 clove garlic
2 tbsp olive oil
2 cup baby spinach
1 pint cherry tomatoes
½ cup crumbled feta
Steps:
Cook the quinoa in 2 cups of water, covered, 15 minutes; fluff.
Mix the oil, minced garlic, the juice of 1 lemon, salt and pepper.
Brush the salmon with the mixture and roast at 400 F for 12 to 14 minutes.
Toss the warm quinoa with the spinach, halved tomatoes, feta and the zest of the second lemon.
Serve the salmon over the quinoa with lemon wedges.

Title: Mediterranean chicken and chickpea sheet pan
Ingredients:
2 lb chicken breast
1 can chickpeas
2 zucchini
1 red onion
1 pint cherry tomatoes
3 tbsp olive oil
2 tsp dried oregano
1 tsp smoked paprika
1 lemon
½ cup plain Greek yogurt
Steps:
Heat the oven to 425 F.
Cut the chicken into chunks; slice the zucchini and onion.
Toss the chicken, drained chickpeas and vegetables with the oil, oregano, paprika and salt on a sheet pan.
Roast 22 to 25 minutes, stirring once, until the chicken reaches 165 F and the chickpeas crisp.
Squeeze over the lemon.
Serve with a spoon of Greek yogurt.

Title: Greek lemon chicken orzo soup
Ingredients:
1½ lb chicken breast
1 cup orzo
8 cup chicken broth
3 eggs
2 lemons
2 carrots
2 stalk celery
1 yellow onion
½ bunch dill
Steps:
Dice the onion, carrots and celery and soften them in a splash of oil 6 minutes.
Add the broth and whole chicken breasts and simmer 15 minutes. Lift out and shred the chicken.
Add the orzo and simmer 8 minutes.
Whisk the eggs with the juice of both lemons. Slowly whisk in 2 ladles of hot broth to temper them.
Off the heat, stir the egg mixture into the pot; the soup turns silky. Do not boil again.
Return the chicken, season, and finish with chopped dill.

Title: Spinach feta stuffed chicken
Ingredients:
4 chicken breasts, about 8 oz each
3 cup baby spinach
½ cup crumbled feta
3 oz light cream cheese
2 clove garlic
1 tbsp olive oil
1 tsp dried oregano
1 lemon
1 lb asparagus
Steps:
Heat the oven to 400 F.
Wilt the spinach with the garlic in a skillet 2 minutes; squeeze dry and mix with the feta and cream cheese.
Cut a deep pocket into the side of each breast and stuff it with the filling. Secure with toothpicks.
Season with oregano, salt and pepper and sear in the oil 3 minutes per side.
Move to the oven with the asparagus alongside and bake 15 to 18 minutes until 165 F.
Squeeze lemon over the top.

Title: Moussaka-style beef and eggplant bake
Ingredients:
1½ lb lean ground beef
2 eggplant
1 can crushed tomatoes
1 yellow onion
3 clove garlic
1 tsp ground cinnamon
1 tsp dried oregano
1 cup plain Greek yogurt
2 eggs
½ cup grated parmesan
Steps:
Heat the oven to 400 F. Slice the eggplant into rounds, brush with a little oil, and roast 20 minutes.
Brown the beef with the diced onion 8 minutes, then add the garlic, cinnamon and oregano.
Add the tomatoes and simmer 15 minutes.
Whisk the yogurt, eggs and half the parmesan for the topping.
Layer eggplant and meat sauce in a baking dish, then spread the yogurt topping and the rest of the parmesan.
Bake 30 minutes until golden. Rest 10 minutes before slicing.

Title: Kung pao chicken
Ingredients:
1½ lb chicken breast
1½ cup rice
⅓ cup unsalted peanuts
1 red bell pepper
1 zucchini
6 dried red chilies
3 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp rice vinegar
1 tbsp honey
1 tbsp cornstarch
3 clove garlic
1 tbsp vegetable oil
Steps:
Cook the rice in 3 cups of water, covered, 18 minutes.
Dice the chicken and toss with the cornstarch and 1 tablespoon soy sauce.
Whisk the remaining soy sauce, vinegar, honey and 2 tablespoons water.
Fry the chilies in hot oil 30 seconds, add the chicken, and stir-fry 5 minutes until cooked.
Add the diced pepper and zucchini and the garlic; cook 2 minutes.
Pour in the sauce and peanuts and toss until glossy. Serve over rice.

Title: Orange chicken (baked)
Ingredients:
1½ lb chicken breast
1½ cup rice
2 eggs
¾ cup cornstarch
2 oranges
3 tbsp soy sauce
2 tbsp honey
1 tbsp rice vinegar
2 clove garlic
1 tbsp grated ginger
1 head broccoli
Steps:
Heat the oven to 425 F and line a sheet pan with parchment.
Cut the chicken into bite-size pieces, dip in beaten egg, then toss in cornstarch. Spread out and spray with oil.
Bake 20 minutes, flipping halfway, until crisp.
Cook the rice and steam the broccoli.
Simmer the juice and zest of the oranges with the soy sauce, honey, vinegar, garlic and ginger 4 minutes until syrupy.
Toss the chicken in the sauce and serve with rice and broccoli.

Title: Mapo tofu with pork
Ingredients:
2 block firm tofu
8 oz lean ground pork
1½ cup rice
2 tbsp chili bean paste
2 tbsp soy sauce
3 clove garlic
1 tbsp grated ginger
1 cup chicken broth
1 tbsp cornstarch
1 bunch green onions
1 tsp Sichuan peppercorns
Steps:
Cook the rice in 3 cups of water, covered, 18 minutes.
Cut the tofu into 1-inch cubes and simmer them in salted water 3 minutes; drain.
Brown the pork 5 minutes, then add the chili bean paste, garlic and ginger for 1 minute.
Add the broth and soy sauce and bring to a simmer.
Slide in the tofu and simmer 5 minutes, then thicken with the cornstarch mixed into 2 tablespoons water.
Top with ground Sichuan pepper and sliced green onions. Serve over rice.

Title: Sesame ginger beef noodles
Ingredients:
1 lb flank steak
8 oz lo mein or spaghetti noodles
1 red bell pepper
2 cup snap peas
2 carrots
3 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp sesame oil
1 tbsp honey
1 tbsp grated ginger
2 clove garlic
1 tbsp sesame seeds
Steps:
Cook the noodles per the package; drain and toss with a little sesame oil.
Slice the steak thin across the grain.
Whisk the soy sauce, honey, ginger, garlic and remaining sesame oil.
Sear the beef in a hot oiled wok 2 minutes; set aside.
Stir-fry the sliced pepper, snap peas and carrots 3 minutes.
Return the beef, add the noodles and sauce, and toss 1 minute. Finish with sesame seeds.

Title: Chicken katsu with cabbage
Ingredients:
1½ lb chicken breast
1½ cup rice
2 eggs
1½ cup panko breadcrumbs
½ cup flour
½ head green cabbage
¼ cup tonkatsu sauce
1 lemon
Steps:
Heat the oven to 425 F and set a rack on a sheet pan.
Pound the chicken to an even ½ inch and season with salt.
Dredge in flour, dip in beaten egg, and press into the panko. Spray both sides with oil.
Bake 18 to 20 minutes, flipping once, until golden and 165 F.
Cook the rice and shred the cabbage very fine; dress it with lemon juice and a pinch of salt.
Slice the katsu and serve with rice, cabbage and tonkatsu sauce.

Title: Beef and veggie yakisoba
Ingredients:
1 lb sirloin, thinly sliced
12 oz yakisoba or ramen noodles
½ head green cabbage
2 carrots
1 yellow onion
4 oz shiitake mushrooms
3 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
2 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp ketchup
1 tbsp sugar
1 tbsp vegetable oil
Steps:
Mix the Worcestershire, soy sauce, ketchup and sugar for the sauce.
Cook the noodles per the package and drain.
Sear the beef in hot oil 2 minutes; set aside.
Stir-fry the sliced onion, carrots, mushrooms and cabbage 5 minutes until wilted but crisp.
Add the noodles, beef and sauce and toss 2 minutes until coated.
Serve hot.

Title: Miso salmon with bok choy
Ingredients:
4 salmon fillets, 6 oz each
1 cup rice
3 tbsp white miso
1 tbsp honey
1 tbsp rice vinegar
1 tbsp soy sauce
4 head baby bok choy
1 tbsp sesame oil
2 clove garlic
Steps:
Heat the broiler with a rack 6 inches below it.
Whisk the miso, honey, vinegar and soy sauce and spread over the salmon.
Broil 8 to 10 minutes until caramelized and flaky.
Cook the rice in 2 cups of water, covered, 18 minutes.
Halve the bok choy and stir-fry it with the sesame oil and garlic 4 minutes.
Serve the salmon with rice and bok choy.

Title: Bibimbap
Ingredients:
1 lb lean ground beef
1½ cup rice
4 eggs
2 cup baby spinach
2 carrots
1 zucchini
2 cup bean sprouts
3 tbsp gochujang
2 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp sesame oil
1 tbsp honey
2 clove garlic
Steps:
Cook the rice in 3 cups of water, covered, 18 minutes.
Brown the beef with the garlic, soy sauce and honey 7 minutes.
Quickly sauté each vegetable separately in a little sesame oil: spinach 1 minute, carrots and zucchini 3 minutes, sprouts 2 minutes. Salt each lightly.
Fry the eggs sunny-side up.
Thin the gochujang with 1 tablespoon water and the last of the sesame oil.
Arrange rice, beef and vegetables in bowls, top each with an egg, and serve with the sauce to stir through.

Title: Korean spicy chicken (dak bulgogi)
Ingredients:
2 lb chicken thighs, boneless skinless
1½ cup rice
3 tbsp gochujang
2 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp honey
1 tbsp sesame oil
4 clove garlic
1 tbsp grated ginger
1 yellow onion
1 bunch green onions
1 cucumber
Steps:
Mix the gochujang, soy sauce, honey, sesame oil, garlic and ginger. Marinate the sliced chicken and onion 20 minutes.
Cook the rice in 3 cups of water, covered, 18 minutes.
Cook the chicken in a hot skillet 8 to 10 minutes until charred at the edges and cooked through.
Slice the cucumber and dress it with a pinch of salt and a splash of vinegar.
Serve the chicken over rice with green onions and cucumber.

Title: Pad thai with chicken
Ingredients:
1 lb chicken breast
8 oz flat rice noodles
2 eggs
2 cup bean sprouts
1 bunch green onions
3 tbsp fish sauce
2 tbsp brown sugar
2 tbsp tamarind paste or lime juice
⅓ cup unsalted peanuts
2 clove garlic
2 limes
1 tbsp vegetable oil
Steps:
Soak the noodles in hot water 8 minutes until pliable; drain.
Whisk the fish sauce, brown sugar and tamarind for the sauce.
Slice the chicken thin and stir-fry in the oil 4 minutes; add the garlic.
Push to the side, scramble the eggs, then add the noodles and sauce and toss 2 minutes.
Add the sprouts and green onions and toss 1 minute more.
Serve with chopped peanuts and lime wedges.

Title: Thai green curry chicken
Ingredients:
1½ lb chicken breast
1½ cup jasmine rice
1 can light coconut milk
3 tbsp green curry paste
1 red bell pepper
1 zucchini
1 cup green beans
1 tbsp fish sauce
1 tsp sugar
1 bunch Thai basil
1 lime
Steps:
Cook the rice in 3 cups of water, covered, 15 minutes.
Fry the curry paste in a splash of coconut cream 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the sliced chicken and stir to coat, 2 minutes.
Pour in the rest of the coconut milk, the fish sauce and sugar; simmer 5 minutes.
Add the sliced pepper, zucchini and green beans and simmer 5 minutes until tender-crisp.
Stir in the basil and a squeeze of lime. Serve over rice.

Title: Peanut chicken noodles
Ingredients:
1½ lb chicken breast
8 oz whole wheat spaghetti
⅓ cup natural peanut butter
3 tbsp soy sauce
2 tbsp rice vinegar
1 tbsp honey
1 tbsp sriracha
2 clove garlic
2 cup shredded cabbage
2 carrots
1 bunch cilantro
Steps:
Cook the spaghetti; drain and rinse under warm water.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, vinegar, honey, sriracha and garlic with 3 tablespoons hot water until smooth.
Season and cook the chicken in a hot skillet 6 minutes per side; slice.
Shred the carrots.
Toss the noodles with the sauce, cabbage and carrots.
Top with the chicken and cilantro. Good warm or cold.

Title: Larb (Thai chicken salad)
Ingredients:
1½ lb ground chicken
1 cup jasmine rice
3 limes
2 tbsp fish sauce
1 tsp chili flakes
2 shallots
1 bunch mint
1 bunch cilantro
1 head butter lettuce
1 cucumber
Steps:
Toast the uncooked rice in a dry pan until golden, then grind it to a coarse powder (keep 2 tablespoons).
Cook the chicken in a skillet with ¼ cup water 6 minutes, breaking it up, until cooked through.
Off the heat, stir in the lime juice, fish sauce, chili flakes and thin-sliced shallots.
Fold in the torn mint, cilantro and toasted rice powder.
Serve in lettuce cups with cucumber slices.

Title: Cajun shrimp and sausage sheet pan
Ingredients:
1½ lb shrimp, peeled
12 oz chicken andouille sausage
1 lb baby potatoes
2 ear corn
1 lb green beans
2 tbsp olive oil
2 tbsp Cajun seasoning
1 lemon
Steps:
Heat the oven to 425 F.
Halve the potatoes and cut the corn into 2-inch rounds. Toss with half the oil and seasoning and roast 15 minutes.
Slice the sausage and toss it with the green beans and the rest of the oil and seasoning; add to the pan and roast 8 minutes.
Toss the shrimp with a pinch more seasoning, add them to the pan, and roast 6 to 8 minutes until pink.
Squeeze lemon over everything before serving.

Title: Jambalaya
Ingredients:
1 lb chicken breast
8 oz chicken andouille sausage
8 oz shrimp, peeled
1½ cup rice
1 can diced tomatoes
3 cup chicken broth
1 yellow onion
1 green bell pepper
2 stalk celery
3 clove garlic
2 tbsp Cajun seasoning
Steps:
Brown the sliced sausage and cubed chicken in a large pot 6 minutes.
Add the diced onion, pepper and celery and cook 5 minutes; add the garlic and Cajun seasoning for 1 minute.
Stir in the rice, tomatoes and broth and bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer 20 minutes without stirring.
Lay the shrimp on top, cover, and cook 5 minutes more until pink.
Fluff and serve.

Title: Chicken and sausage gumbo
Ingredients:
1½ lb chicken thighs, boneless skinless
8 oz chicken andouille sausage
⅓ cup flour
3 tbsp vegetable oil
1 yellow onion
1 green bell pepper
3 stalk celery
4 clove garlic
6 cup chicken broth
2 tsp Cajun seasoning
2 bay leaf
1 cup rice
Steps:
Cook the flour in the oil over medium heat, stirring constantly, 15 to 20 minutes until it's the color of peanut butter (the roux).
Add the diced onion, pepper and celery and cook 6 minutes; add the garlic.
Slowly whisk in the broth, then add the Cajun seasoning and bay leaves.
Add the cubed chicken and sliced sausage and simmer 40 minutes.
Cook the rice in 2 cups of water, covered, 18 minutes.
Remove the bay leaves, season, and serve the gumbo over rice.

Title: Blackened chicken with dirty rice
Ingredients:
2 lb chicken breast
1 cup rice
8 oz lean ground beef
1 yellow onion
1 green bell pepper
2 stalk celery
2 clove garlic
3 tbsp blackening seasoning
2 cup chicken broth
1 bunch green onions
Steps:
Brown the ground beef 5 minutes, then add the diced onion, pepper and celery for 5 minutes and the garlic for 1.
Stir in the rice and 1 tablespoon seasoning, then the broth. Cover and simmer 18 minutes.
Coat the chicken heavily with the remaining blackening seasoning.
Sear in a very hot cast-iron pan 5 to 6 minutes per side until deeply browned and 165 F.
Slice and serve over the dirty rice with green onions.

Title: Pulled chicken sandwiches
Ingredients:
2 lb chicken breast
4 whole wheat buns
¾ cup BBQ sauce
1 tsp smoked paprika
1 tsp garlic powder
3 cup coleslaw mix
⅓ cup plain Greek yogurt
1 tbsp apple cider vinegar
Steps:
Season the chicken with paprika, garlic powder and salt.
Simmer it in a covered pot with 1 cup water 20 minutes (or slow-cook 4 hours) until it shreds easily.
Shred with two forks and stir in the BBQ sauce; warm through.
Mix the coleslaw with the yogurt, vinegar and a pinch of salt.
Toast the buns, pile on the chicken, and top with slaw.

Title: Oven fried chicken with green beans
Ingredients:
2 lb chicken drumsticks and thighs, skin removed
1 cup buttermilk
1½ cup panko breadcrumbs
⅓ cup flour
2 tsp smoked paprika
1 tsp garlic powder
1 tsp cayenne
1½ lb green beans
1 tbsp olive oil
Steps:
Soak the chicken in buttermilk with a big pinch of salt for 30 minutes or overnight.
Heat the oven to 425 F and set a rack on a sheet pan.
Mix the panko, flour, paprika, garlic powder, cayenne and salt.
Press the chicken into the crumbs, set it on the rack, and spray with oil.
Bake 35 to 40 minutes until crisp and 175 F at the bone.
Roast the green beans with the oil and salt for the last 15 minutes.

Title: Meatloaf with mashed potatoes
Ingredients:
2 lb lean ground beef
½ cup oats
1 egg
1 yellow onion
⅓ cup ketchup
1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
2 lb Yukon gold potatoes
½ cup milk
2 tbsp butter
1 lb green beans
Steps:
Heat the oven to 375 F.
Mix the beef, oats, egg, grated onion, Worcestershire, half the ketchup and salt. Shape into a loaf on a lined pan.
Brush with the remaining ketchup and bake 55 minutes until 160 F inside.
Boil the peeled, cubed potatoes 15 minutes; drain and mash with the milk, butter and salt.
Steam the green beans 5 minutes.
Rest the meatloaf 10 minutes, slice, and serve with potatoes and beans.

Title: Pot roast with carrots and potatoes
Ingredients:
3 lb beef chuck roast
1½ lb baby potatoes
5 carrots
1 yellow onion
4 clove garlic
2 cup beef broth
2 tbsp tomato paste
1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
2 sprig rosemary
2 tbsp flour
Steps:
Season the roast well and sear it on all sides in a hot oiled pot, 10 minutes.
Remove it, then cook the sliced onion and garlic 4 minutes and stir in the tomato paste.
Add the broth and Worcestershire, return the roast, and add the rosemary.
Cover and cook in a 300 F oven 2½ hours.
Add the potatoes and chunked carrots and cook 1 hour more until fork-tender.
Thicken the liquid with the flour mixed into water, simmering 3 minutes, and serve as gravy.

Title: Beef stew
Ingredients:
2 lb beef stew meat
1 lb Yukon gold potatoes
4 carrots
3 stalk celery
1 yellow onion
3 clove garlic
4 cup beef broth
2 tbsp tomato paste
3 tbsp flour
1 tsp dried thyme
1 cup frozen peas
Steps:
Toss the beef with the flour and salt and brown it in batches in a hot oiled pot.
Cook the diced onion and celery 5 minutes, then the garlic and tomato paste for 1 minute.
Add the broth, thyme and beef. Cover and simmer 1½ hours.
Add the cubed potatoes and carrots and simmer 30 minutes until tender.
Stir in the peas for the last 5 minutes.
Season and serve.

Title: Lighter chicken pot pie
Ingredients:
1½ lb chicken breast
1 sheet refrigerated pie crust
2 cup frozen mixed vegetables
1 yellow onion
2 stalk celery
2 cup chicken broth
1 cup milk
⅓ cup flour
2 tbsp butter
1 tsp dried thyme
Steps:
Heat the oven to 400 F. Poach the chicken in the broth 15 minutes; remove, dice, and keep the broth.
Melt the butter and soften the diced onion and celery 5 minutes.
Stir in the flour for 1 minute, then whisk in the broth and milk and simmer until thick.
Add the chicken, vegetables, thyme and salt.
Pour into a deep pie dish, lay the crust on top, and cut a few vents.
Bake 30 minutes until golden. Rest 10 minutes before serving.

Title: Turkey sloppy joes
Ingredients:
1½ lb ground turkey
4 whole wheat buns
1 can tomato sauce
2 tbsp tomato paste
1 green bell pepper
1 yellow onion
1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
1 tbsp brown sugar
1 tsp chili powder
1 tbsp yellow mustard
Steps:
Brown the turkey 7 minutes, breaking it up.
Add the diced onion and pepper and cook 5 minutes.
Stir in the tomato sauce, paste, Worcestershire, brown sugar, chili powder and mustard.
Simmer 10 minutes until thick.
Toast the buns and spoon the filling over them.

Title: Cheeseburger bowls
Ingredients:
1½ lb lean ground beef
1½ lb baby potatoes
1 head romaine
2 tomatoes
½ red onion
4 dill pickles
1 cup shredded cheddar
3 tbsp light mayo
1 tbsp ketchup
1 tsp yellow mustard
Steps:
Heat the oven to 425 F. Halve the potatoes, toss with oil and salt, and roast 25 minutes.
Brown the beef with salt and pepper 7 minutes; drain.
Stir the mayo, ketchup, mustard and a splash of pickle juice together for burger sauce.
Chop the lettuce, tomatoes, onion and pickles.
Build bowls with lettuce, potatoes, beef, cheese and the vegetables, and drizzle with sauce.

Title: Buffalo chicken stuffed sweet potatoes
Ingredients:
4 sweet potatoes
1½ lb chicken breast
⅓ cup hot sauce
2 stalk celery
½ cup plain Greek yogurt
2 tbsp crumbled blue cheese
1 bunch green onions
Steps:
Prick the sweet potatoes and bake at 400 F for 50 minutes (or microwave 10 minutes) until soft.
Poach the chicken in simmering water 15 minutes; shred it and toss with the hot sauce.
Stir the blue cheese into the yogurt.
Split the potatoes and fluff the insides with a fork.
Fill with buffalo chicken and top with diced celery, the blue cheese yogurt and green onions.

Title: Chicken and broccoli rice casserole
Ingredients:
1½ lb chicken breast
1 cup rice
2 head broccoli
2 cup chicken broth
1 cup milk
1½ cup shredded cheddar
1 yellow onion
2 clove garlic
2 tbsp flour
Steps:
Heat the oven to 375 F.
Cook the rice in 2 cups of water, covered, 18 minutes.
Cube the chicken and brown it with the diced onion 6 minutes; add the garlic.
Sprinkle in the flour, then whisk in the broth and milk and simmer until thick. Stir in 1 cup of cheese.
Fold in the rice and small broccoli florets and spread in a baking dish.
Top with the remaining cheese and bake 20 minutes until bubbling.

Title: Shepherd's pie
Ingredients:
1½ lb lean ground beef
2 lb Yukon gold potatoes
2 cup frozen peas and carrots
1 yellow onion
2 tbsp tomato paste
1 cup beef broth
1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
½ cup milk
2 tbsp butter
½ cup shredded cheddar
Steps:
Heat the oven to 400 F. Boil the peeled, cubed potatoes 15 minutes; mash with the milk, butter and salt.
Brown the beef with the diced onion 8 minutes.
Stir in the tomato paste, then the broth, Worcestershire and peas and carrots; simmer 8 minutes until thick.
Spread the filling in a baking dish and top with the mashed potatoes.
Sprinkle with cheese and bake 20 minutes until golden.

Title: Oven fish and chips
Ingredients:
1½ lb cod fillets
2 lb russet potatoes
1 cup panko breadcrumbs
2 eggs
⅓ cup flour
1 tsp smoked paprika
2 tbsp olive oil
1 lemon
2 cup frozen peas
Steps:
Heat the oven to 450 F.
Cut the potatoes into wedges, toss with the oil and salt, and roast 30 minutes, turning once.
Cut the cod into pieces, dredge in flour, dip in egg, and press into the panko mixed with paprika.
Set the fish on an oiled rack and bake 12 minutes until golden and flaky.
Cook the peas and mash them roughly with a little salt and lemon.
Serve the fish with chips, peas and lemon wedges.

Title: Japanese chicken curry
Ingredients:
1½ lb chicken thighs, boneless skinless
1½ cup rice
1 box Japanese curry roux, half used
2 yellow onions
3 carrots
2 Yukon gold potatoes
1 apple
1 tbsp vegetable oil
Steps:
Cook the rice in 3 cups of water, covered, 18 minutes.
Brown the chicken pieces in the oil, then add the sliced onions and cook 8 minutes until soft.
Add the chunked carrots, potatoes and grated apple with 3 cups water.
Simmer 20 minutes until the vegetables are tender.
Turn off the heat and stir in half the curry roux until melted, then simmer 5 minutes until thick.
Serve over rice.

Title: Lamb kofta with yogurt sauce
Ingredients:
1½ lb ground lamb or lean beef
1 yellow onion
3 clove garlic
1 bunch parsley
2 tsp ground cumin
1 tsp ground coriander
1 tsp ground cinnamon
1 cup plain Greek yogurt
1 cucumber
4 whole wheat pitas
2 tomatoes
Steps:
Grate the onion and squeeze out the juice. Mix it with the meat, garlic, chopped parsley, spices and salt.
Shape into 12 long koftas, on skewers if you have them.
Grill or broil 8 to 10 minutes, turning, until browned and cooked through.
Stir grated cucumber, salt and a squeeze of lemon into the yogurt.
Warm the pitas.
Serve the koftas in pitas with tomatoes and yogurt sauce.

Title: Shakshuka with feta
Ingredients:
8 eggs
2 can crushed tomatoes
1 red bell pepper
1 yellow onion
3 clove garlic
2 tsp ground cumin
1 tsp smoked paprika
½ cup crumbled feta
1 bunch parsley
4 slice whole grain bread
Steps:
Cook the diced onion and pepper in a splash of oil 8 minutes.
Add the garlic, cumin and paprika for 1 minute.
Pour in the tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes until thick; season.
Make 8 wells and crack an egg into each.
Cover and cook 6 to 8 minutes until the whites set but the yolks are runny.
Scatter the feta and parsley and serve with toast.

Title: Stuffed bell peppers
Ingredients:
6 bell peppers
1½ lb lean ground beef
1 cup rice
1 can diced tomatoes
1 yellow onion
2 clove garlic
1 tsp Italian seasoning
1 cup shredded mozzarella
Steps:
Heat the oven to 375 F. Cook the rice in 2 cups of water, covered, 18 minutes.
Cut the tops off the peppers and scoop out the seeds.
Brown the beef with the diced onion and garlic 8 minutes; stir in the tomatoes, rice and Italian seasoning.
Stuff the peppers and stand them in a baking dish with ½ cup water.
Cover with foil and bake 35 minutes.
Top with mozzarella and bake uncovered 10 minutes more.

Title: Chicken quesadillas
Ingredients:
1½ lb cooked chicken breast, shredded
8 whole wheat tortillas
1½ cup shredded Mexican cheese
1 red bell pepper
1 can black beans
1 tsp chili powder
½ cup salsa
½ cup plain Greek yogurt
Steps:
Dice the pepper and cook it 4 minutes in a dry skillet; mix with the chicken, drained beans and chili powder.
Lay out 4 tortillas, spread with the filling, and sprinkle with cheese. Top with the other tortillas.
Cook each quesadilla in a skillet over medium heat 3 minutes per side until golden and melted.
Cut into wedges.
Serve with salsa and Greek yogurt.

Title: Breakfast burritos
Ingredients:
8 eggs
4 large whole wheat tortillas
8 oz turkey breakfast sausage
1 lb frozen diced potatoes
1 cup shredded cheddar
1 red bell pepper
½ cup salsa
Steps:
Roast the potatoes at 425 F for 20 minutes until crisp.
Brown the sausage, breaking it up, with the diced pepper 6 minutes.
Scramble the eggs softly with a pinch of salt.
Warm the tortillas and fill with eggs, sausage, potatoes and cheese.
Roll tightly. Eat now with salsa, or wrap in foil and freeze for busy mornings.

Title: Protein pancakes with berries
Ingredients:
1 cup oats
1 cup cottage cheese
4 eggs
1 scoop vanilla protein powder
1 tsp baking powder
1 tsp vanilla
2 cup mixed berries
2 tbsp maple syrup
Steps:
Blend the oats, cottage cheese, eggs, protein powder, baking powder and vanilla until smooth. Rest 5 minutes.
Heat a nonstick pan over medium and lightly oil it.
Pour ¼-cup scoops and cook until bubbles form, about 2 minutes; flip and cook 1 minute more.
Keep warm while you cook the rest.
Serve topped with berries and a little maple syrup.

Title: Overnight oats with Greek yogurt
Ingredients:
2 cup oats
2 cup plain Greek yogurt
2 cup milk
2 scoop vanilla protein powder
2 tbsp chia seeds
2 cup mixed berries
2 tbsp honey
Steps:
Whisk the yogurt, milk, protein powder and honey until smooth.
Stir in the oats and chia seeds.
Divide into 4 jars and refrigerate overnight.
In the morning, stir and top with berries. Eat cold or warm 1 minute in the microwave.

Title: Egg and veggie muffin cups
Ingredients:
12 eggs
2 cup baby spinach
1 red bell pepper
½ red onion
1 cup shredded cheddar
4 oz diced ham
Steps:
Heat the oven to 350 F and grease a 12-cup muffin tin.
Chop the spinach, pepper and onion and divide them with the ham among the cups.
Whisk the eggs with salt and pepper and pour over the vegetables.
Top with cheese.
Bake 20 to 22 minutes until set in the center. Cool 5 minutes before removing. Keeps 4 days in the fridge.

Title: Greek yogurt parfaits
Ingredients:
3 cup plain Greek yogurt
1 cup low-sugar granola
2 cup mixed berries
2 tbsp honey
2 tbsp chopped almonds
Steps:
Stir the honey into the yogurt.
Layer yogurt, berries and granola in 4 glasses or jars.
Repeat the layers once more.
Top with almonds. Add the granola right before eating if you prep these ahead so it stays crunchy.

Title: Steak and eggs with potatoes
Ingredients:
1½ lb sirloin steak
8 eggs
1½ lb baby potatoes
1 yellow onion
1 green bell pepper
1 tbsp olive oil
1 tsp smoked paprika
Steps:
Dice the potatoes, onion and pepper; cook them in the oil with paprika and salt over medium heat 15 to 18 minutes until crisp.
Season the steak and sear in a hot pan 4 minutes per side. Rest 5 minutes and slice.
Fry or scramble the eggs.
Serve the steak and eggs with the potato hash.

Title: Turkey sausage and egg hash
Ingredients:
12 oz turkey breakfast sausage
6 eggs
2 sweet potatoes
1 yellow onion
2 cup baby spinach
1 tbsp olive oil
Steps:
Dice the sweet potatoes small and cook them in the oil, covered, 10 minutes, then uncovered 5 minutes to crisp.
Add the sausage and diced onion and cook 6 minutes, breaking up the sausage.
Stir in the spinach until wilted.
Make 6 wells, crack in the eggs, cover, and cook 5 to 6 minutes until the whites set.
Season and serve from the pan.

Title: Smoked salmon bagels
Ingredients:
4 whole wheat bagels
8 oz smoked salmon
4 oz light cream cheese
1 cucumber
½ red onion
2 tbsp capers
1 lemon
Steps:
Split and toast the bagels.
Stir a squeeze of lemon into the cream cheese.
Spread each bagel half with cream cheese.
Layer on smoked salmon, thin cucumber slices, red onion and capers.
Finish with black pepper.

Title: Banana oat protein muffins
Ingredients:
3 ripe bananas
2 cup oats
2 eggs
1 cup plain Greek yogurt
2 scoop vanilla protein powder
1 tsp baking powder
1 tsp cinnamon
⅓ cup dark chocolate chips
Steps:
Heat the oven to 350 F and line a 12-cup muffin tin.
Blend the bananas, oats, eggs, yogurt, protein powder, baking powder and cinnamon until smooth.
Fold in the chocolate chips.
Fill the cups three-quarters full.
Bake 18 to 20 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean. Cool before storing.

Title: Cobb salad
Ingredients:
1½ lb chicken breast
2 head romaine
4 eggs
6 slice turkey bacon
2 tomatoes
1 avocado
½ cup crumbled blue cheese
⅓ cup light ranch dressing
Steps:
Hard-boil the eggs 10 minutes, cool in ice water, and quarter.
Season and cook the chicken 6 to 7 minutes per side; slice.
Cook the turkey bacon until crisp and crumble it.
Chop the romaine and lay it on plates.
Arrange rows of chicken, egg, bacon, diced tomato, avocado and blue cheese.
Drizzle with dressing.

Title: Chicken Caesar salad
Ingredients:
1½ lb chicken breast
2 head romaine
1 cup whole grain croutons
½ cup grated parmesan
⅓ cup light Caesar dressing
1 lemon
Steps:
Season the chicken with salt, pepper and lemon zest and cook it 6 to 7 minutes per side. Rest and slice.
Chop the romaine.
Toss with the dressing, a squeeze of lemon and half the parmesan.
Top with chicken, croutons and the rest of the parmesan.

Title: Asian sesame chicken salad
Ingredients:
1½ lb chicken breast
4 cup shredded cabbage
2 carrots
1 red bell pepper
1 cup shelled edamame
1 bunch green onions
3 tbsp rice vinegar
2 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp sesame oil
1 tbsp honey
2 tbsp sesame seeds
Steps:
Cook the chicken 6 to 7 minutes per side; cool and slice.
Whisk the vinegar, soy sauce, sesame oil and honey.
Shred the carrots and slice the pepper and green onions.
Toss the cabbage, vegetables and edamame with the dressing.
Top with chicken and sesame seeds.

Title: Southwest chicken salad
Ingredients:
1½ lb chicken breast
2 head romaine
1 can black beans
1 cup frozen corn, thawed
1 pint cherry tomatoes
1 avocado
½ cup shredded cheddar
½ cup salsa
½ cup plain Greek yogurt
1 tsp chili powder
1 lime
Steps:
Rub the chicken with chili powder and salt and cook it 6 to 7 minutes per side; slice.
Stir the salsa into the yogurt with a squeeze of lime for dressing.
Chop the romaine and halve the tomatoes.
Toss the lettuce with the beans, corn and tomatoes.
Top with chicken, avocado and cheese and spoon over the dressing.

Title: Tuna and white bean salad
Ingredients:
3 can tuna in water
2 can cannellini beans
1 cucumber
1 pint cherry tomatoes
½ red onion
1 bunch parsley
3 tbsp olive oil
2 tbsp red wine vinegar
1 tsp Dijon mustard
4 cup arugula
Steps:
Whisk the oil, vinegar, mustard, salt and pepper.
Drain the tuna and beans.
Dice the cucumber and onion and halve the tomatoes.
Toss everything except the arugula with the dressing and chopped parsley.
Serve over arugula.

Title: Steak salad with blue cheese
Ingredients:
1½ lb sirloin steak
6 cup mixed greens
1 pint cherry tomatoes
½ red onion
½ cup crumbled blue cheese
⅓ cup balsamic vinaigrette
½ cup walnuts
Steps:
Season the steak and sear it 4 to 5 minutes per side. Rest 8 minutes and slice thin.
Toast the walnuts in a dry pan 3 minutes.
Toss the greens, halved tomatoes and sliced onion with the vinaigrette.
Top with steak, blue cheese and walnuts.

Title: Quinoa and black bean salad
Ingredients:
1½ cup quinoa
2 can black beans
1 cup frozen corn, thawed
1 red bell pepper
½ red onion
1 bunch cilantro
2 limes
3 tbsp olive oil
1 tsp ground cumin
1 avocado
Steps:
Cook the quinoa in 3 cups of water, covered, 15 minutes; spread out to cool.
Whisk the lime juice, oil, cumin and salt.
Dice the pepper and onion and chop the cilantro.
Toss the quinoa, drained beans, corn and vegetables with the dressing.
Top with diced avocado. Keeps 4 days in the fridge.

Title: Salmon nicoise salad
Ingredients:
4 salmon fillets, 5 oz each
1 lb baby potatoes
½ lb green beans
4 eggs
1 head butter lettuce
1 pint cherry tomatoes
⅓ cup olives
3 tbsp olive oil
2 tbsp red wine vinegar
1 tsp Dijon mustard
Steps:
Boil the potatoes 12 minutes, adding the green beans for the last 3 minutes; drain.
Hard-boil the eggs 10 minutes and halve them.
Season the salmon and roast at 400 F 12 minutes.
Whisk the oil, vinegar, mustard and salt.
Arrange lettuce, potatoes, beans, eggs, tomatoes, olives and salmon on plates and drizzle with dressing.

Title: Split pea soup with ham
Ingredients:
1 lb dried split peas
8 oz diced ham
1 yellow onion
2 carrots
2 stalk celery
2 clove garlic
8 cup chicken broth
2 bay leaf
1 tsp dried thyme
Steps:
Rinse the split peas.
Soften the diced onion, carrots and celery in a splash of oil 6 minutes; add the garlic.
Add the peas, broth, bay leaves and thyme.
Simmer partly covered 1 hour, stirring now and then, until the peas break down.
Stir in the ham and simmer 10 minutes more.
Remove the bay leaves and season.

Title: Beef and barley soup
Ingredients:
1½ lb beef stew meat
1 cup pearl barley
8 cup beef broth
3 carrots
3 stalk celery
1 yellow onion
8 oz mushrooms
2 clove garlic
1 tsp dried thyme
Steps:
Brown the beef in batches in a hot oiled pot.
Add the diced onion, carrots, celery and sliced mushrooms and cook 6 minutes; add the garlic.
Add the broth and thyme, cover, and simmer 1 hour.
Add the barley and simmer 40 minutes until tender.
Season and serve.

Title: White chicken chili
Ingredients:
1½ lb chicken breast
2 can great northern beans
1 can diced green chilies
4 cup chicken broth
1 yellow onion
3 clove garlic
2 tsp ground cumin
1 tsp dried oregano
½ cup plain Greek yogurt
½ cup shredded Monterey jack
1 lime
Steps:
Soften the diced onion in a splash of oil 5 minutes; add the garlic, cumin and oregano for 1 minute.
Add the broth, chilies, 1 can of beans and the whole chicken breasts. Simmer 20 minutes.
Shred the chicken.
Mash the second can of beans and stir it in with the chicken to thicken; simmer 5 minutes.
Off the heat, stir in the yogurt and lime juice.
Serve topped with cheese.

Title: Tomato basil soup with turkey grilled cheese
Ingredients:
2 can crushed tomatoes
2 cup chicken broth
1 yellow onion
3 clove garlic
1 bunch basil
½ cup half-and-half
8 slice whole grain bread
8 oz sliced turkey breast
4 slice cheddar
Steps:
Soften the diced onion in a splash of oil 6 minutes; add the garlic.
Add the tomatoes and broth and simmer 15 minutes.
Blend until smooth, stir in the half-and-half and torn basil, and season.
Build sandwiches with turkey and cheese.
Toast them in a skillet 3 minutes per side until golden and melted.
Serve the soup with the sandwiches for dipping.

Title: Hamburger veggie soup
Ingredients:
1½ lb lean ground beef
1 can diced tomatoes
6 cup beef broth
1 lb Yukon gold potatoes
2 cup frozen mixed vegetables
1 yellow onion
2 clove garlic
1 tsp Italian seasoning
Steps:
Brown the beef with the diced onion 8 minutes; drain.
Add the garlic and Italian seasoning for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, broth and cubed potatoes and simmer 15 minutes.
Add the mixed vegetables and simmer 10 minutes.
Season and serve.

Title: Chicken and dumplings
Ingredients:
1½ lb chicken breast
6 cup chicken broth
2 carrots
2 stalk celery
1 yellow onion
1½ cup flour
2 tsp baking powder
¾ cup milk
2 tbsp butter
1 tsp dried thyme
Steps:
Soften the diced onion, carrots and celery in the butter 6 minutes.
Add the broth, thyme and whole chicken; simmer 15 minutes. Shred the chicken and return it.
Mix the flour, baking powder and a pinch of salt; stir in the milk just until combined.
Drop spoonfuls of dough onto the simmering soup.
Cover and cook 15 minutes without lifting the lid until the dumplings are fluffy.
Season and serve.

Title: Teriyaki chicken and pineapple skewers
Ingredients:
2 lb chicken breast
1½ cup jasmine rice
1 fresh pineapple
2 red bell peppers
1 red onion
⅓ cup soy sauce
2 tbsp honey
1 tbsp grated ginger
2 clove garlic
1 tbsp cornstarch
Steps:
Simmer the soy sauce, honey, ginger, garlic and ½ cup water with the cornstarch until thick. Save half for serving.
Cut the chicken, pineapple, peppers and onion into chunks and thread onto skewers.
Cook the rice in 3 cups of water, covered, 15 minutes.
Grill or broil the skewers 10 to 12 minutes, turning and brushing with sauce, until the chicken reaches 165 F.
Serve over rice with the reserved sauce.

Title: Honey garlic shrimp and broccoli
Ingredients:
1½ lb shrimp, peeled
1½ cup rice
2 head broccoli
3 tbsp honey
3 tbsp soy sauce
4 clove garlic
1 tbsp cornstarch
1 tbsp vegetable oil
Steps:
Cook the rice in 3 cups of water, covered, 18 minutes.
Whisk the honey, soy sauce, cornstarch and ¼ cup water.
Steam the broccoli florets in a covered skillet with a splash of water 3 minutes; set aside.
Cook the shrimp in the hot oil 2 minutes per side; add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Pour in the sauce and simmer 1 minute until glossy, then toss in the broccoli.
Serve over rice.

Title: Tofu and veggie stir fry with cashews
Ingredients:
2 block extra-firm tofu
1½ cup rice
1 head broccoli
1 red bell pepper
2 cup snap peas
⅓ cup cashews
3 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp maple syrup
1 tbsp cornstarch
2 clove garlic
1 tbsp grated ginger
Steps:
Press the tofu 15 minutes, cube it, and toss with the cornstarch.
Cook the rice in 3 cups of water, covered, 18 minutes.
Pan-fry the tofu in a little oil 8 minutes, turning, until crisp; set aside.
Stir-fry the vegetables 4 minutes; add the garlic and ginger.
Whisk the soy sauce, maple syrup and 2 tablespoons water; add with the tofu and cashews and toss.
Serve over rice.

Title: Chicken gyros with tzatziki
Ingredients:
2 lb chicken thighs, boneless skinless
4 whole wheat pitas
1 cup plain Greek yogurt
1 cucumber
2 tomatoes
½ red onion
2 lemons
3 clove garlic
2 tsp dried oregano
1 tsp smoked paprika
Steps:
Marinate the chicken with the juice of 1 lemon, 2 cloves garlic, oregano, paprika and salt for 20 minutes.
Cook the chicken in a hot skillet 5 to 6 minutes per side until charred. Rest and slice thin.
Grate half the cucumber, squeeze it dry, and stir it into the yogurt with the last garlic clove and lemon juice.
Slice the tomatoes, onion and the rest of the cucumber.
Warm the pitas and fill with chicken, vegetables and tzatziki.

Title: Beef and black bean chili mac
Ingredients:
1 lb lean ground beef
8 oz elbow macaroni
1 can black beans
1 can diced tomatoes
2 cup beef broth
1 yellow onion
2 tbsp chili powder
1 tsp ground cumin
1 cup shredded cheddar
Steps:
Brown the beef with the diced onion 8 minutes; drain.
Stir in the chili powder and cumin for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, broth, drained beans and uncooked macaroni.
Cover and simmer 12 minutes, stirring now and then, until the pasta is tender.
Stir in half the cheese, then top with the rest and cover 2 minutes to melt.

Title: Jerk chicken with rice and peas
Ingredients:
2 lb chicken thighs, boneless skinless
1½ cup rice
1 can kidney beans
1 can light coconut milk
3 tbsp jerk seasoning
2 limes
1 bunch green onions
1 tsp dried thyme
2 clove garlic
Steps:
Rub the chicken with the jerk seasoning, lime juice and salt; marinate 20 minutes.
Simmer the rice with the coconut milk, 1½ cups water, drained beans, thyme, garlic and a pinch of salt, covered, 18 minutes.
Grill or broil the chicken 6 to 7 minutes per side until charred and 165 F.
Fluff the rice and peas.
Serve the chicken over the rice with sliced green onions and lime wedges.

Title: Basque Garlic Chicken & Potatoes
Ingredients:
2 lb chicken thighs
1½ lb baby potatoes
1 head garlic
1 red bell pepper
1 tsp smoked paprika
½ cup chicken broth
2 tbsp olive oil
2 tbsp chopped parsley
Salt to taste
Steps:
Heat the oven to 425 F. Halve the potatoes and slice the bell pepper into strips.
Pat the chicken dry and season with salt and the smoked paprika.
Brown the chicken skin-side down in the olive oil in an ovenproof skillet, 6 minutes; set aside.
Add the potatoes, pepper and peeled garlic cloves to the pan, toss in the fat, and pour in the broth.
Nestle the chicken on top and roast 30 to 35 minutes, until the chicken reaches 165 F and the potatoes are tender.
Scatter with parsley and spoon the garlicky pan juices over everything.

Title: BBQ Chicken Naan Pizzas
Ingredients:
4 naan flatbreads
1 lb cooked chicken breast
½ cup barbecue sauce
1 cup shredded part-skim mozzarella
½ red onion
2 tbsp chopped cilantro
1 tsp olive oil
Steps:
Heat the oven to 450 F and set the naan on a sheet pan.
Shred the chicken and toss it with 6 tablespoons of the barbecue sauce.
Brush the naan lightly with oil, then spread the rest of the sauce over them.
Top with the chicken, thinly sliced red onion and the mozzarella.
Bake 8 to 10 minutes, until the cheese bubbles and the edges crisp.
Finish with cilantro, slice into wedges and serve.

Title: Beef Bourguignon-Style Potatoes
Ingredients:
2 lb beef chuck
1 lb baby potatoes
8 oz cremini mushrooms
2 carrots
1 onion
2 cloves garlic
1 cup beef broth
1 cup red wine
2 tbsp tomato paste
1 tsp dried thyme
1 tbsp olive oil
Salt to taste
Steps:
Cut the beef into 1½-inch cubes, pat dry and season with salt.
Brown the beef in batches in the olive oil in a Dutch oven; set aside.
Cook the chopped onion and sliced carrots 5 minutes, then stir in the garlic and tomato paste for 1 minute.
Pour in the wine, scraping up the browned bits, then add the broth, thyme and the beef.
Cover and simmer gently 1 hour.
Add the halved potatoes and quartered mushrooms and simmer 30 minutes more, until the beef is fork-tender and the sauce coats a spoon.

Title: Beef Daube with Carrots & Potatoes
Ingredients:
2 lb beef chuck
1 lb potatoes
4 carrots
1 onion
3 cloves garlic
1 can diced tomatoes
1 cup red wine
1 cup beef broth
1 strip orange zest
1 tsp herbes de Provence
1 tbsp olive oil
Salt to taste
Steps:
Heat the oven to 325 F. Cut the beef into large cubes and season with salt.
Brown the beef in the olive oil in a Dutch oven, in batches; set aside.
Soften the sliced onion and garlic 4 minutes, then add the wine and scrape the pot.
Return the beef with the tomatoes, broth, orange zest and herbes de Provence; bring to a simmer.
Cover and braise in the oven 1½ hours.
Add the carrots and potatoes in chunks and braise 45 minutes more, until everything is tender. Remove the zest before serving.

Title: Beef Empanada-Style Rice Bowls
Ingredients:
1½ lb 93% lean ground beef
1½ cup rice
1 onion
1 red bell pepper
2 hard-boiled eggs
¼ cup green olives
1 tsp ground cumin
1 tsp sweet paprika
1 tbsp olive oil
Salt to taste
Steps:
Cook the rice in 3 cups of salted water, covered, 18 minutes.
Cook the diced onion and pepper in the olive oil 6 minutes, until soft.
Add the beef, cumin and paprika and cook, breaking it up, until browned, 7 minutes. Season with salt.
Stir in the sliced olives.
Chop the hard-boiled eggs.
Serve the beef over rice, topped with the chopped egg — the classic empanada filling in a bowl.

Title: Beef Kofta with Tomato Orzo
Ingredients:
1½ lb 93% lean ground beef
1½ cup orzo
1 can crushed tomatoes
½ onion
2 cloves garlic
2 tbsp chopped parsley
1 tsp ground cumin
1 tsp ground coriander
½ cup plain Greek yogurt
Salt to taste
Steps:
Grate the onion and mix it with the beef, half the garlic, the parsley, cumin, coriander and a big pinch of salt.
Shape into 12 oval kofta.
Sear the kofta in a hot skillet 3 minutes per side; set aside.
In the same pan, cook the rest of the garlic 30 seconds, add the tomatoes and 2 cups of water, and bring to a boil.
Stir in the orzo, nestle in the kofta, cover and simmer 12 minutes, stirring once, until the orzo is tender.
Serve with a spoon of Greek yogurt.

Title: Beef Parmesan Risotto
Ingredients:
1 lb sirloin steak
1½ cup arborio rice
5 cup low-sodium beef broth
1 onion
½ cup grated Parmesan
2 cup baby spinach
1 tbsp olive oil
1 tbsp butter
Salt to taste
Steps:
Keep the broth warm in a small pot.
Season the steak, sear it in the oil 3 to 4 minutes per side, rest, then slice thin.
Cook the diced onion in the butter 4 minutes, add the rice and toast 1 minute.
Add the broth a ladle at a time, stirring, letting each addition absorb, about 18 minutes.
When the rice is creamy and just tender, stir in the Parmesan and spinach until wilted.
Top each bowl with the sliced steak.

Title: Beef Picadillo Rice Bowls
Ingredients:
1½ lb 93% lean ground beef
1½ cup rice
1 can tomato sauce
1 onion
1 green bell pepper
2 cloves garlic
¼ cup green olives
2 tbsp raisins
1 tsp ground cumin
1 tsp dried oregano
Salt to taste
Steps:
Cook the rice in 3 cups of salted water, covered, 18 minutes.
Brown the beef in a large skillet, breaking it up, 6 minutes.
Add the diced onion, pepper and garlic and cook 5 minutes.
Stir in the tomato sauce, cumin, oregano, olives and raisins with ¼ cup of water.
Simmer 10 minutes, until thick and glossy; season with salt.
Spoon the picadillo over the rice.

Title: Beef Picadinho with Potatoes
Ingredients:
1½ lb sirloin
1 lb potatoes
1 onion
2 tomatoes
3 cloves garlic
1 cup beef broth
1 tbsp olive oil
2 tbsp chopped parsley
Salt to taste
Steps:
Cut the sirloin into ½-inch cubes and season with salt.
Sear the beef in batches in the hot oil until browned; set aside.
Cook the diced onion and garlic 4 minutes, then add the chopped tomatoes.
Add the potatoes in ½-inch cubes and the broth; cover and simmer 15 minutes.
Return the beef and simmer 5 minutes more, until the potatoes are tender and the sauce thick.
Finish with parsley.

Title: Beef Sukiyaki-Style Rice Bowls
Ingredients:
