1¼ lb thinly sliced sirloin
1½ cup short-grain rice
1 onion
8 oz shiitake mushrooms
4 green onions
7 oz firm tofu
¼ cup low-sodium soy sauce
2 tbsp mirin
1 tbsp sugar
½ cup water
Steps:
Rinse the rice and cook it with 1¾ cups of water, covered, 15 minutes; rest 10 minutes.
Mix the soy sauce, mirin, sugar and water into a sweet broth.
Simmer the sliced onion and mushrooms in the broth 5 minutes.
Add the cubed tofu and the beef, spreading the slices out; simmer 2 minutes until just cooked.
Add the green onions in 2-inch pieces for the last 30 seconds.
Spoon the beef, vegetables and some broth over bowls of rice.

Title: Beef & Zucchini Bolognese
Ingredients:
1 lb 93% lean ground beef
12 oz spaghetti
2 zucchini
1 carrot
1 onion
2 cloves garlic
1 can crushed tomatoes
2 tbsp tomato paste
¼ cup grated Parmesan
Salt to taste
Steps:
Finely dice the onion and carrot and grate one zucchini.
Brown the beef in a large pot, then add the onion, carrot and garlic for 5 minutes.
Stir in the tomato paste, then the crushed tomatoes and grated zucchini; simmer 25 minutes.
Cook the spaghetti in salted water; slice the second zucchini into half-moons and add for the last 2 minutes.
Drain and toss the pasta and zucchini into the sauce.
Serve with Parmesan.

Title: Blackened Trout & Roasted Potatoes
Ingredients:
1½ lb trout fillets
1½ lb baby potatoes
1 tbsp Cajun seasoning
1 tsp smoked paprika
2 tbsp olive oil
1 lemon
1 lb green beans
Salt to taste
Steps:
Heat the oven to 425 F. Halve the potatoes, toss with 1 tablespoon oil and salt, and roast 25 minutes.
Add the trimmed green beans to the pan for the last 10 minutes.
Mix the Cajun seasoning with the paprika and press it onto the flesh side of the trout.
Sear the trout spice-side down in the rest of the oil in a very hot skillet, 3 minutes.
Flip and cook 1 to 2 minutes more, until it flakes.
Serve with the potatoes, beans and lemon wedges.

Title: Black Pepper Beef & Broccoli
Ingredients:
1¼ lb flank steak
1½ cup jasmine rice
1 lb broccoli florets
1 onion
3 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce
1 tbsp oyster sauce
2 tsp coarse black pepper
1 tbsp cornstarch
1 tbsp avocado oil
Steps:
Cook the rice in 2¼ cups of water, covered, 15 minutes.
Slice the steak thin across the grain and toss with 1 tablespoon soy sauce and the cornstarch.
Steam the broccoli 3 minutes, until bright green.
Sear the beef in the hot oil in two batches, 1 minute per side; set aside.
Stir-fry the sliced onion 2 minutes, then return the beef and broccoli with the rest of the soy sauce, the oyster sauce and the pepper.
Toss 1 minute until glossy and serve over rice.

Title: Brazilian Beef, Rice & Peas
Ingredients:
1½ lb 93% lean ground beef
1½ cup rice
1 cup frozen peas
1 onion
3 cloves garlic
2 tomatoes
1 tsp sweet paprika
1 tbsp olive oil
2 tbsp chopped parsley
Salt to taste
Steps:
Sauté half the onion and 1 garlic clove in the oil, add the rice and toast 1 minute, then add 3 cups of salted water; cover and cook 18 minutes.
Brown the beef with the rest of the onion and garlic, 8 minutes.
Add the chopped tomatoes and paprika and simmer 5 minutes.
Stir in the peas and cook 3 minutes.
Season with salt and finish with parsley.
Serve the beef over the garlic rice.

Title: Bulgogi Chicken Rice Bowls
Ingredients:
1½ lb chicken breast
1½ cup short-grain rice
¼ cup low-sodium soy sauce
1 Asian pear
3 cloves garlic
1 tbsp grated ginger
1 tbsp honey
1 tsp toasted sesame oil
4 green onions
1 cucumber
Steps:
Cook the rice in 2 cups of water, covered, 15 minutes.
Grate the pear and mix it with the soy sauce, garlic, ginger, honey and sesame oil.
Slice the chicken thin and marinate it 15 minutes.
Cook the chicken in a very hot skillet in batches, 3 minutes per batch, letting the edges caramelize.
Slice the cucumber and green onions.
Serve the chicken over rice with cucumber and green onions.

Title: Caramel Pork with Cucumber Rice
Ingredients:
1½ lb pork tenderloin
1½ cup jasmine rice
3 tbsp brown sugar
2 tbsp fish sauce
1 shallot
2 cloves garlic
1 cucumber
1 tbsp rice vinegar
1 tsp black pepper
1 tbsp avocado oil
Steps:
Cook the rice in 2¼ cups of water, covered, 15 minutes.
Slice the cucumber thin and toss with the rice vinegar and a pinch of salt.
Cut the pork into bite-size pieces.
Melt the brown sugar with 2 tablespoons of water in a skillet until amber, about 3 minutes.
Add the oil, sliced shallot, garlic and pork; cook 6 minutes, then add the fish sauce and pepper and simmer until sticky, 4 minutes.
Serve over rice with the cucumbers.

Title: Chicken Chile Verde Rice Bowls
Ingredients:
1½ lb chicken breast
1½ cup rice
1 lb tomatillos
2 poblano peppers
1 jalapeño
1 onion
3 cloves garlic
½ cup chopped cilantro
1 cup chicken broth
1 lime
Salt to taste
Steps:
Cook the rice in 3 cups of salted water, covered, 18 minutes.
Broil the husked tomatillos, poblanos, jalapeño and onion 8 minutes, turning, until charred.
Peel and seed the peppers, then blend everything with the garlic, cilantro and broth.
Simmer the salsa verde with the chicken breasts in a covered pot 18 minutes, until cooked through.
Shred the chicken back into the sauce and add lime juice and salt.
Serve over rice.

Title: Chicken & Chorizo-Style Paella
Ingredients:
1½ lb chicken thighs
4 oz Spanish chorizo
1½ cup bomba rice
1 onion
1 red bell pepper
3 cloves garlic
1 can diced tomatoes
4 cup chicken broth
1 pinch saffron
1 tsp smoked paprika
1 cup frozen peas
1 lemon
Steps:
Warm the broth and crumble in the saffron.
Brown the chicken pieces in a wide pan 6 minutes; add the sliced chorizo for the last 2 minutes.
Add the onion, pepper and garlic and cook 5 minutes, then the tomatoes and paprika for 3 minutes.
Scatter the rice evenly, pour in the broth and do not stir again.
Simmer 18 minutes, adding the peas in the last 5, until the rice is tender and a crust forms underneath.
Rest 5 minutes off the heat and serve with lemon wedges.

Title: Chicken Dijon Risotto
Ingredients:
1½ lb chicken breast
1½ cup arborio rice
5 cup low-sodium chicken broth
1 shallot
2 tbsp Dijon mustard
¼ cup grated Parmesan
1 tbsp butter
1 tbsp olive oil
2 tbsp chopped tarragon
Salt to taste
Steps:
Season the chicken, sear it in the oil 6 minutes per side, rest and slice.
Keep the broth warm.
Cook the minced shallot in the butter 2 minutes, add the rice and toast 1 minute.
Add the broth a ladle at a time, stirring often, about 18 minutes, until creamy.
Stir in the Dijon, Parmesan and tarragon.
Top with the sliced chicken.

Title: Chicken Fajita Potatoes with Jalapeños
Ingredients:
1½ lb chicken breast
1½ lb Yukon Gold potatoes
2 bell peppers
1 onion
2 jalapeños
1 tbsp chili powder
1 tsp ground cumin
2 tbsp olive oil
1 lime
½ cup plain Greek yogurt
Steps:
Heat the oven to 425 F. Cube the potatoes, toss with 1 tablespoon oil and salt, and roast 15 minutes.
Slice the chicken, peppers and onion into strips; slice the jalapeños into rings.
Toss the chicken and vegetables with the rest of the oil, chili powder, cumin and salt.
Add them to the potato pan and roast 18 to 20 minutes, until the chicken reaches 165 F.
Squeeze lime over everything.
Serve with Greek yogurt in place of sour cream.

Title: Chicken Fried Rice
Ingredients:
1¼ lb chicken breast
4 cup cooked day-old rice
3 eggs
1 cup frozen peas and carrots
4 green onions
2 cloves garlic
3 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce
1 tsp toasted sesame oil
1 tbsp avocado oil
Steps:
Dice the chicken small and season with 1 tablespoon soy sauce.
Scramble the eggs in half the oil, break them up and set aside.
Stir-fry the chicken in the rest of the oil 5 minutes, until cooked.
Add the garlic, peas and carrots for 2 minutes.
Add the cold rice and press it against the hot pan, tossing, 4 minutes.
Return the eggs, add the rest of the soy sauce, the sesame oil and green onions, and toss.

Title: Chicken Katsu-Style Rice Bowls
Ingredients:
1½ lb chicken breast
1½ cup short-grain rice
1 cup panko
1 egg
¼ cup flour
2 cup shredded cabbage
¼ cup tonkatsu sauce
1 tbsp avocado oil
Salt to taste
Steps:
Cook the rice in 2 cups of water, covered, 15 minutes.
Heat the oven to 425 F. Butterfly the chicken and pound it ½ inch thick; season with salt.
Dredge in flour, then beaten egg, then panko toasted in the oil.
Bake on a rack 18 minutes, until golden and 165 F inside.
Slice into strips.
Serve over rice with the cabbage and a drizzle of tonkatsu sauce.

Title: Chicken Marsala-Style Orzo
Ingredients:
1½ lb chicken breast
1½ cup orzo
8 oz cremini mushrooms
1 shallot
½ cup Marsala wine
2½ cup chicken broth
1 tbsp butter
1 tbsp olive oil
2 tbsp chopped parsley
Salt to taste
Steps:
Slice the chicken into cutlets, season and sear in the oil 3 minutes per side; set aside.
Cook the sliced mushrooms and shallot in the butter 5 minutes.
Pour in the Marsala and let it bubble 1 minute.
Add the broth and the orzo, cover and simmer 10 minutes, stirring once.
Nestle the chicken back in and simmer 3 minutes more, until the orzo is tender and the chicken cooked through.
Finish with parsley.

Title: Chicken Milanesa with Parmesan Potatoes
Ingredients:
1½ lb chicken breast
1½ lb potatoes
1 cup panko
2 eggs
¼ cup grated Parmesan
2 cloves garlic
1 tbsp chopped parsley
2 tbsp olive oil
1 lemon
Salt to taste
Steps:
Heat the oven to 425 F. Cut the potatoes into wedges, toss with 1 tablespoon oil and salt, and roast 30 minutes; toss with half the Parmesan for the last 5.
Pound the chicken into thin cutlets.
Beat the eggs with the garlic, parsley and a pinch of salt.
Dip the cutlets in the egg, then in panko mixed with the rest of the Parmesan.
Pan-fry in the rest of the oil 3 minutes per side, until golden and cooked through.
Serve with the potatoes and lemon wedges.

Title: Chicken Moqueca-Style Rice
Ingredients:
1½ lb chicken breast
1½ cup rice
1 can light coconut milk
1 can diced tomatoes
1 onion
1 red bell pepper
3 cloves garlic
1 lime
1 tsp sweet paprika
¼ cup chopped cilantro
Salt to taste
Steps:
Cook the rice in 3 cups of salted water, covered, 18 minutes.
Cube the chicken and toss with lime juice, garlic and salt.
Layer the sliced onion and pepper in a pot, then the chicken and tomatoes.
Pour over the coconut milk mixed with the paprika.
Cover and simmer 20 minutes without stirring, until the chicken is cooked through.
Finish with cilantro and serve over rice.

Title: Chicken, Olive & Tomato Orzo
Ingredients:
1½ lb chicken breast
1½ cup orzo
1 pint cherry tomatoes
½ cup Kalamata olives
2 cloves garlic
1 tsp dried oregano
3 cup chicken broth
¼ cup crumbled feta
1 tbsp olive oil
1 lemon
Steps:
Cut the chicken into chunks and season with oregano and salt.
Brown the chicken in the oil 5 minutes; add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the orzo and broth, bring to a boil, cover and simmer 8 minutes.
Stir in the halved tomatoes and the olives and cook 3 minutes more.
Squeeze in the lemon.
Serve topped with feta.

Title: Chicken Parmesan Risotto
Ingredients:
1½ lb chicken breast
1½ cup arborio rice
5 cup low-sodium chicken broth
1 onion
1 cup marinara sauce
½ cup grated Parmesan
½ cup shredded part-skim mozzarella
1 tbsp olive oil
2 tbsp chopped basil
Steps:
Season the chicken, sear it in the oil 6 minutes per side, then slice.
Keep the broth warm.
Cook the diced onion 4 minutes, add the rice and toast 1 minute.
Add the broth a ladle at a time, stirring, about 18 minutes, until creamy.
Stir in the Parmesan.
Top with the chicken, warm marinara, mozzarella (melt it under the broiler 2 minutes) and basil.

Title: Chicken Parm Pasta Bake
Ingredients:
1½ lb chicken breast
12 oz penne
2 cup marinara sauce
1 cup shredded part-skim mozzarella
¼ cup grated Parmesan
½ cup panko
1 tsp Italian seasoning
1 tbsp olive oil
Steps:
Heat the oven to 400 F. Cook the penne 2 minutes short of the package time and drain.
Cube the chicken, season with Italian seasoning and salt, and brown in the oil 6 minutes.
Toss the pasta, chicken and marinara in a baking dish.
Top with the mozzarella, then the panko mixed with the Parmesan.
Bake 20 minutes, until bubbling and golden on top.
Rest 5 minutes before serving.

Title: Chicken Pesto Orzo with Broccoli
Ingredients:
1½ lb chicken breast
1½ cup orzo
1 lb broccoli florets
¼ cup basil pesto
¼ cup grated Parmesan
1 lemon
1 tbsp olive oil
Salt to taste
Steps:
Cook the orzo in salted boiling water 9 minutes, adding the broccoli for the last 3; drain, saving ½ cup of the water.
Cut the chicken into bite-size pieces and season with salt.
Cook the chicken in the oil 6 to 7 minutes, until cooked through.
Toss the orzo and broccoli with the pesto, Parmesan and a splash of the pasta water.
Fold in the chicken.
Finish with lemon zest and juice.

Title: Chicken with Tomato Olive Salsa
Ingredients:
1½ lb chicken breast
1 cup farro
1 pint cherry tomatoes
⅓ cup Castelvetrano olives
1 tbsp capers
1 shallot
2 tbsp chopped basil
2 tbsp olive oil
1 tbsp red wine vinegar
Salt to taste
Steps:
Simmer the farro in salted water 25 minutes, until chewy-tender; drain.
Chop the tomatoes and olives and mix with the minced shallot, capers, basil, vinegar and 1 tablespoon oil.
Pound the chicken to an even ¾ inch and season with salt.
Sear the chicken in the rest of the oil 5 to 6 minutes per side, until 165 F.
Rest 5 minutes and slice.
Serve the chicken over farro with the salsa spooned on top.

Title: Chili Garlic Shrimp with Bok Choy
Ingredients:
1½ lb shrimp
1½ cup jasmine rice
1 lb baby bok choy
4 cloves garlic
2 tbsp chili garlic sauce
2 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce
1 tsp honey
1 tbsp avocado oil
2 green onions
Steps:
Cook the rice in 2¼ cups of water, covered, 15 minutes.
Halve the bok choy lengthwise.
Whisk the chili garlic sauce, soy sauce and honey.
Sear the bok choy cut-side down in half the oil 2 minutes, then steam with a splash of water 1 minute; set aside.
Stir-fry the garlic in the rest of the oil 20 seconds, add the shrimp and cook 2 minutes per side, then add the sauce and toss.
Serve the shrimp and bok choy over rice, scattered with green onions.

Title: Chili Lime Shrimp Noodle Bowls
Ingredients:
1½ lb shrimp
8 oz rice noodles
2 limes
2 tbsp fish sauce
1 tbsp sweet chili sauce
1 cucumber
2 carrots
½ cup chopped cilantro
¼ cup chopped peanuts
1 tbsp avocado oil
Steps:
Soak or cook the rice noodles per the package, then rinse under cold water.
Whisk the juice of the limes with the fish sauce and sweet chili sauce.
Cut the cucumber and carrots into matchsticks.
Sear the shrimp in the oil 2 minutes per side; toss with 2 tablespoons of the dressing.
Toss the noodles and vegetables with the rest of the dressing.
Top with the shrimp, cilantro and peanuts.

Title: Chipotle Beef & Black Bean Rice
Ingredients:
1¼ lb 93% lean ground beef
1½ cup rice
1 can black beans
2 chipotle peppers in adobo
1 can diced tomatoes
1 onion
1 tsp ground cumin
1 lime
¼ cup chopped cilantro
Salt to taste
Steps:
Cook the rice in 3 cups of salted water, covered, 18 minutes; stir in lime juice and cilantro.
Brown the beef with the diced onion, 8 minutes.
Mince the chipotles and add them with 1 tablespoon adobo sauce and the cumin.
Add the tomatoes and the rinsed black beans; simmer 8 minutes.
Season with salt.
Serve over the cilantro-lime rice.

Title: Cod & Tomato Orzo Skillet
Ingredients:
1½ lb cod fillets
1½ cup orzo
1 can diced tomatoes
2½ cup chicken broth
2 cloves garlic
1 tsp dried oregano
2 cup baby spinach
¼ cup crumbled feta
1 tbsp olive oil
1 lemon
Steps:
Cook the garlic in the oil in a deep skillet 30 seconds.
Add the orzo, tomatoes, broth and oregano; bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer 7 minutes.
Season the cod and nestle it into the orzo; cover and cook 8 minutes, until it flakes.
Stir the spinach in around the fish to wilt.
Finish with lemon and feta.

Title: Cod with Tomato Olive Couscous
Ingredients:
1½ lb cod fillets
1½ cup couscous
1 pint cherry tomatoes
⅓ cup green olives
1 tsp ground cumin
1 tsp sweet paprika
1½ cup chicken broth
2 tbsp chopped parsley
1 tbsp olive oil
1 lemon
Steps:
Bring the broth to a boil, stir in the couscous, cover and let it stand 5 minutes; fluff.
Rub the cod with the cumin, paprika and salt.
Roast the cod and the tomatoes at 425 F for 12 minutes, until the fish flakes.
Chop the olives.
Fold the blistered tomatoes, olives, parsley and lemon juice into the couscous.
Serve the cod on top.

Title: Crab & Parmesan Orzo Bake
Ingredients:
1 lb lump crab meat
1½ cup orzo
2½ cup chicken broth
½ cup grated Parmesan
1 cup frozen peas
2 cloves garlic
1 lemon
½ cup panko
1 tbsp butter
Steps:
Heat the oven to 400 F.
Melt the butter in an ovenproof skillet, add the garlic and orzo and toast 1 minute.
Add the broth and simmer 8 minutes, stirring.
Off the heat, fold in the peas, crab, lemon zest and most of the Parmesan.
Top with the panko mixed with the rest of the Parmesan.
Bake 12 minutes, until golden.

Title: Creamy Tuscan Chicken Pasta
Ingredients:
1½ lb chicken breast
12 oz penne
½ cup sun-dried tomatoes
3 cup baby spinach
3 cloves garlic
1 cup chicken broth
½ cup light cream
¼ cup grated Parmesan
1 tsp Italian seasoning
1 tbsp olive oil
Steps:
Cook the penne in salted water; drain.
Cut the chicken into strips, season with Italian seasoning and salt, and cook in the oil 6 minutes; set aside.
Cook the garlic and chopped sun-dried tomatoes 1 minute.
Add the broth and cream and simmer 4 minutes.
Stir in the Parmesan and spinach until wilted.
Toss in the pasta and chicken.

Title: Dakgalbi-Style Chicken & Rice
Ingredients:
1½ lb chicken thighs
1½ cup short-grain rice
2 tbsp gochujang
2 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce
1 tbsp honey
3 cloves garlic
½ head cabbage
1 sweet potato
1 onion
1 tbsp avocado oil
Steps:
Cook the rice in 2 cups of water, covered, 15 minutes.
Mix the gochujang, soy sauce, honey and garlic; toss with the chicken in bite-size pieces.
Slice the sweet potato thin and cut the cabbage and onion into chunks.
Cook the sweet potato in the oil 5 minutes in a big skillet.
Add the chicken and cook 6 minutes, then the cabbage and onion for 5 more, until the chicken is cooked and the cabbage tender.
Serve over rice.

Title: Dijon Pork with Parmesan Potatoes
Ingredients:
1½ lb pork tenderloin
1½ lb baby potatoes
2 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 tbsp honey
2 cloves garlic
¼ cup grated Parmesan
1 lb green beans
2 tbsp olive oil
Salt to taste
Steps:
Heat the oven to 425 F. Halve the potatoes, toss with 1 tablespoon oil and salt, and roast 15 minutes.
Mix the Dijon, honey and garlic and rub it over the pork.
Sear the pork in the rest of the oil 4 minutes, turning.
Add the pork and the green beans to the potato pan and roast 18 minutes, until the pork reads 145 F.
Toss the potatoes with the Parmesan and roast 3 minutes more while the pork rests.
Slice the pork and serve.

Title: Garlic Beef & Green Onion Rice
Ingredients:
1¼ lb flank steak
1½ cup jasmine rice
8 green onions
5 cloves garlic
3 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce
1 tbsp oyster sauce
1 tbsp cornstarch
1 tbsp avocado oil
Steps:
Cook the rice in 2¼ cups of water, covered, 15 minutes.
Slice the steak thin across the grain and toss with 1 tablespoon soy sauce and the cornstarch.
Cut the green onions into 2-inch pieces and slice the garlic.
Sear the beef in the oil in two batches, 1 minute per side; set aside.
Stir-fry the garlic and green onions 1 minute, then return the beef with the rest of the soy sauce and the oyster sauce.
Toss until glossy and serve over rice.

Title: Garlic Butter Chicken & Orzo
Ingredients:
1½ lb chicken breast
1½ cup orzo
3 cup chicken broth
5 cloves garlic
2 tbsp butter
3 cup baby spinach
¼ cup grated Parmesan
1 lemon
Salt to taste
Steps:
Cut the chicken into bite-size pieces and season with salt.
Brown the chicken in 1 tablespoon butter 6 minutes; set aside.
Melt the rest of the butter and cook the garlic 1 minute.
Add the orzo and broth, cover and simmer 10 minutes, stirring once.
Stir in the spinach, Parmesan, lemon juice and the chicken.
Serve hot.

Title: Garlic Butter Lobster Rice
Ingredients:
1¼ lb lobster tail meat
1½ cup rice
3 cup seafood or chicken broth
4 cloves garlic
2 tbsp butter
1 cup frozen corn
2 tbsp chopped chives
1 lemon
Salt to taste
Steps:
Toast the rice in 1 tablespoon butter 1 minute, add the broth, cover and cook 18 minutes.
Cut the lobster into chunks.
Melt the rest of the butter with the garlic 1 minute.
Add the lobster and corn and cook 3 to 4 minutes, until the lobster is opaque.
Fold the lobster and garlic butter into the rice with lemon juice.
Finish with chives.

Title: Garlic Butter Shrimp Orzo
Ingredients:
1½ lb shrimp
1½ cup orzo
3 cup chicken broth
5 cloves garlic
2 tbsp butter
1 pint cherry tomatoes
2 tbsp chopped parsley
1 lemon
Salt to taste
Steps:
Simmer the orzo in the broth, covered, 10 minutes, stirring once.
Season the shrimp with salt.
Melt the butter and cook the garlic 30 seconds.
Add the shrimp and halved tomatoes and cook 3 minutes, until the shrimp are pink.
Fold everything into the orzo with lemon juice.
Finish with parsley.

Title: Garlic Chicken & Bok Choy
Ingredients:
1½ lb chicken breast
1½ cup jasmine rice
1 lb baby bok choy
5 cloves garlic
3 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce
1 tbsp oyster sauce
1 tsp cornstarch
1 tbsp avocado oil
Steps:
Cook the rice in 2¼ cups of water, covered, 15 minutes.
Slice the chicken thin and toss with 1 tablespoon soy sauce and the cornstarch.
Stir-fry the chicken in the oil 5 minutes; set aside.
Cook the sliced garlic 30 seconds, add the halved bok choy and a splash of water, and cook 3 minutes.
Return the chicken with the rest of the soy sauce and the oyster sauce.
Serve over rice.

Title: Garlic Cod & Potato Stew
Ingredients:
1½ lb cod fillets
1½ lb potatoes
1 onion
6 cloves garlic
1 can diced tomatoes
3 cup fish or chicken broth
1 bay leaf
1 tsp sweet paprika
1 tbsp olive oil
2 tbsp chopped parsley
Steps:
Cook the sliced onion and garlic in the oil 5 minutes.
Add the paprika, tomatoes, broth and bay leaf.
Add the potatoes in 1-inch chunks and simmer 15 minutes.
Cut the cod into large pieces, season and lay it on top.
Cover and simmer 8 minutes, until the cod flakes.
Remove the bay leaf and finish with parsley.

Title: Garlic Lime Chicken Rice Bowls
Ingredients:
1½ lb chicken breast
1½ cup rice
2 limes
4 cloves garlic
1 tsp ground cumin
1 can pinto beans
1 cup pico de gallo
1 avocado
1 tbsp olive oil
Salt to taste
Steps:
Cook the rice in 3 cups of salted water, covered, 18 minutes.
Mix the juice of 1 lime with the garlic, cumin, oil and salt; marinate the chicken 10 minutes.
Cook the chicken in a hot skillet 6 minutes per side, until 165 F; rest and slice.
Warm and drain the beans.
Build bowls with rice, beans, chicken and pico de gallo.
Top with sliced avocado and lime wedges.

Title: Garlic Pork Tenderloin Risotto
Ingredients:
1¼ lb pork tenderloin
1½ cup arborio rice
5 cup low-sodium chicken broth
6 cloves garlic
1 onion
¼ cup grated Parmesan
1 tbsp butter
1 tbsp olive oil
1 tsp dried rosemary
Salt to taste
Steps:
Rub the pork with half the garlic, the rosemary and salt; sear in the oil, then roast at 425 F 15 minutes, to 145 F. Rest and slice.
Keep the broth warm.
Cook the onion and the rest of the garlic in the butter 4 minutes; toast the rice 1 minute.
Add the broth a ladle at a time, stirring, about 18 minutes.
Stir in the Parmesan.
Serve topped with the sliced pork.

Title: Garlic Salmon Pasta Primavera
Ingredients:
1¼ lb salmon fillet
12 oz penne
1 zucchini
1 red bell pepper
1 cup frozen peas
4 cloves garlic
¼ cup grated Parmesan
1 lemon
1 tbsp olive oil
Steps:
Cook the penne in salted water; save ½ cup of the water, then drain.
Roast the seasoned salmon at 425 F for 12 minutes; flake into chunks.
Dice the zucchini and pepper and cook in the oil 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and peas for 2 minutes.
Toss in the pasta, Parmesan, lemon juice and a splash of the pasta water.
Fold in the salmon.

Title: Garlic Shrimp & Tomato Rice
Ingredients:
1½ lb shrimp
1½ cup rice
1 can crushed tomatoes
1 onion
5 cloves garlic
2½ cup chicken broth
1 tsp sweet paprika
1 tbsp olive oil
2 tbsp chopped cilantro
Steps:
Cook the onion and garlic in the oil 4 minutes.
Add the rice and paprika and toast 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and broth, cover and simmer 18 minutes — it should stay a little loose.
Season the shrimp and nestle them into the rice.
Cover and cook 4 minutes, until the shrimp are pink.
Finish with cilantro.

Title: Garlic Shrimp Bibimbap Bowls
Ingredients:
1¼ lb shrimp
1½ cup short-grain rice
4 eggs
2 carrots
3 cup baby spinach
1 zucchini
1 cup bean sprouts
4 cloves garlic
2 tbsp gochujang
1 tsp toasted sesame oil
Steps:
Cook the rice in 2 cups of water, covered, 15 minutes.
Sauté each vegetable separately with a little garlic: carrots and zucchini in matchsticks 3 minutes, spinach 1 minute, sprouts 1 minute.
Cook the shrimp with the rest of the garlic 2 minutes per side.
Fry the eggs sunny-side up.
Thin the gochujang with the sesame oil and 1 tablespoon water.
Top bowls of rice with the vegetables, shrimp and an egg, and drizzle with the sauce.

Title: Garlic Shrimp Chimichurri Couscous
Ingredients:
1½ lb shrimp
1½ cup couscous
1½ cup chicken broth
1 cup parsley
3 cloves garlic
2 tbsp red wine vinegar
2 tbsp olive oil
½ tsp red pepper flakes
1 pint cherry tomatoes
Steps:
Pour the boiling broth over the couscous, cover 5 minutes and fluff.
Chop the parsley and garlic fine and mix with the vinegar, oil, pepper flakes and a pinch of salt.
Toss the shrimp with 2 tablespoons of the chimichurri.
Cook the shrimp in a hot skillet 2 minutes per side.
Fold the halved tomatoes into the couscous.
Top with the shrimp and the rest of the chimichurri.

Title: Garlic Shrimp Couscous
Ingredients:
1½ lb shrimp
1½ cup couscous
1½ cup chicken broth
5 cloves garlic
1 tsp ground cumin
1 can chickpeas
2 tbsp chopped mint
1 lemon
1 tbsp olive oil
Steps:
Pour the boiling broth over the couscous, cover 5 minutes and fluff.
Rinse the chickpeas and warm them in a skillet with half the oil and the cumin.
Cook the garlic in the rest of the oil 30 seconds, add the shrimp and cook 2 minutes per side.
Fold the chickpeas into the couscous.
Top with the shrimp.
Finish with mint and lemon juice.

Title: Garlic Shrimp Paella
Ingredients:
1½ lb shrimp
1½ cup bomba rice
4 cup seafood or chicken broth
1 pinch saffron
1 onion
1 red bell pepper
5 cloves garlic
1 tsp smoked paprika
1 cup frozen peas
1 tbsp olive oil
1 lemon
Steps:
Warm the broth with the saffron.
Cook the onion, pepper and garlic in the oil in a wide pan 6 minutes.
Stir in the paprika and rice, then pour in the broth and spread evenly; do not stir again.
Simmer 15 minutes.
Press the shrimp and peas into the rice and cook 5 minutes more, until the shrimp are pink and a crust forms.
Rest 5 minutes and serve with lemon.

Title: Garlic Shrimp Rice Bowls
Ingredients:
1½ lb shrimp
1½ cup rice
8 cloves garlic
2 tbsp butter
1 tsp paprika
2 cup shredded cabbage
1 lemon
2 green onions
Salt to taste
Steps:
Cook the rice in 3 cups of salted water, covered, 18 minutes.
Toss the shrimp with the paprika and salt.
Melt the butter and cook the minced garlic until golden, 2 minutes.
Add the shrimp and cook 2 minutes per side, spooning the garlic butter over.
Squeeze in the lemon.
Serve over rice with cabbage and green onions — North Shore shrimp-truck style.

Title: Garlic Shrimp Yakimeshi
Ingredients:
1¼ lb shrimp
4 cup cooked day-old rice
3 eggs
5 cloves garlic
4 green onions
1 cup frozen peas
2 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce
1 tbsp butter
1 tbsp avocado oil
Steps:
Scramble the eggs in half the oil and set aside.
Fry the sliced garlic in the butter until golden.
Add the shrimp and cook 2 minutes; push to the side.
Add the rest of the oil, the rice and peas, and press against the pan 4 minutes.
Add the soy sauce, eggs and green onions and toss.
Serve hot.

Title: Ginger Beef & Edamame Rice
Ingredients:
1¼ lb flank steak
1½ cup short-grain rice
1½ cup shelled edamame
2 tbsp grated ginger
3 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce
1 tbsp mirin
1 tsp honey
1 tbsp avocado oil
2 green onions
Steps:
Cook the rice in 2 cups of water, covered, 15 minutes.
Boil the edamame 4 minutes; drain.
Slice the steak thin across the grain.
Mix the ginger, soy sauce, mirin and honey.
Sear the beef in the oil in batches, 1 minute per side, then add the sauce and edamame and toss.
Serve over rice with green onions.

Title: Ginger Chicken & Bok Choy Rice
Ingredients:
1½ lb chicken breast
1½ cup jasmine rice
3 cup chicken broth
3 tbsp grated ginger
3 cloves garlic
1 lb baby bok choy
3 green onions
2 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce
1 tsp toasted sesame oil
Steps:
Poach the chicken in the broth with 1 tablespoon ginger, covered, 15 minutes; rest and slice. Keep the broth.
Cook the rice in 2¼ cups of the poaching broth with the garlic, covered, 15 minutes.
Blanch the bok choy in the rest of the broth 2 minutes.
Mix the rest of the ginger with the chopped green onions, sesame oil and a pinch of salt.
Serve the chicken over the rice with the bok choy.
Spoon the ginger-scallion sauce and a little soy sauce on top.

Title: Ginger Pork Donburi
Ingredients:
1¼ lb pork loin
1½ cup short-grain rice
1 onion
2 tbsp grated ginger
3 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce
2 tbsp mirin
1 tsp honey
2 cup shredded cabbage
1 tbsp avocado oil
Steps:
Cook the rice in 2 cups of water, covered, 15 minutes.
Slice the pork very thin.
Mix the ginger, soy sauce, mirin and honey.
Cook the sliced onion in the oil 3 minutes, add the pork and cook 3 minutes.
Pour in the sauce and simmer 2 minutes until glossy (shoga-yaki).
Serve over rice with the cabbage.

Title: Gochujang Beef Bowls
Ingredients:
1¼ lb 93% lean ground beef
1½ cup short-grain rice
2 tbsp gochujang
2 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce
1 tbsp honey
3 cloves garlic
1 cucumber
2 carrots
4 green onions
1 tsp toasted sesame oil
Steps:
Cook the rice in 2 cups of water, covered, 15 minutes.
Whisk the gochujang, soy sauce, honey and sesame oil.
Brown the beef with the garlic, 7 minutes.
Stir in the sauce and simmer 2 minutes.
Cut the cucumber and carrots into matchsticks.
Serve the beef over rice with the vegetables and green onions.

Title: Gochujang Salmon Rice Bowls
Ingredients:
1½ lb salmon fillet
1½ cup short-grain rice
2 tbsp gochujang
1 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce
1 tbsp honey
1 cucumber
1 cup shelled edamame
1 avocado
2 green onions
Steps:
Cook the rice in 2 cups of water, covered, 15 minutes.
Heat the oven to 425 F. Mix the gochujang, soy sauce and honey.
Cut the salmon into 4 portions and brush with most of the glaze.
Roast 10 to 12 minutes, until it flakes; brush with the rest of the glaze.
Boil the edamame 4 minutes and slice the cucumber and avocado.
Build bowls with rice, salmon, vegetables and green onions.

Title: Grilled Steak with Tomato Chimichurri Rice
Ingredients:
1½ lb flank steak
1½ cup rice
1 cup parsley
3 cloves garlic
2 tomatoes
2 tbsp red wine vinegar
2 tbsp olive oil
1 tsp dried oregano
½ tsp red pepper flakes
Salt to taste
Steps:
Cook the rice in 3 cups of salted water, covered, 18 minutes.
Chop the parsley and garlic fine and mix with the vinegar, oil, oregano and pepper flakes; fold in the diced tomatoes.
Season the steak well with salt.
Grill or sear over high heat 4 to 5 minutes per side for medium-rare; rest 5 minutes.
Fold half the tomato chimichurri into the rice.
Slice the steak across the grain and serve with the rest of the chimichurri.

Title: Herbes de Provence Chicken & Potatoes
Ingredients:
2 lb chicken thighs
1½ lb baby potatoes
1 tbsp herbes de Provence
1 red onion
1 head garlic
1 lemon
2 tbsp olive oil
1 lb green beans
Salt to taste
Steps:
Heat the oven to 425 F.
Toss the halved potatoes, onion wedges and unpeeled garlic cloves with 1 tablespoon oil, half the herbs and salt.
Rub the chicken with the rest of the oil, herbs, lemon zest and salt; set on top.
Roast 35 minutes.
Add the green beans and roast 10 minutes more, until the chicken reaches 165 F.
Squeeze the lemon over and serve with the soft roasted garlic.

Title: Korean Beef & Potato Bowls
Ingredients:
1¼ lb 93% lean ground beef
1½ lb Yukon Gold potatoes
3 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce
1 tbsp honey
3 cloves garlic
1 tbsp gochugaru
1 onion
2 carrots
4 green onions
1 tbsp avocado oil
Steps:
Cut the potatoes and carrots into ¾-inch cubes.
Cook them in the oil 5 minutes, then add ½ cup of water, the soy sauce and honey, cover and simmer 12 minutes (gamja-jorim style).
Brown the beef with the onion and garlic in another pan, 7 minutes.
Season the beef with the gochugaru.
Combine the beef with the glazed potatoes and carrots.
Top with green onions.

Title: Lemon Chicken Couscous Bowls
Ingredients:
1½ lb chicken breast
1½ cup couscous
1½ cup chicken broth
2 lemons
3 cloves garlic
1 tsp ground cumin
1 tsp ground turmeric
1 cucumber
1 pint cherry tomatoes
2 tbsp chopped mint
Steps:
Mix the juice of 1 lemon with the garlic, cumin, turmeric and salt; marinate the chicken 10 minutes.
Pour the boiling broth over the couscous, cover 5 minutes and fluff.
Cook the chicken in a hot skillet 6 minutes per side, until 165 F; slice.
Dice the cucumber and halve the tomatoes.
Fold them into the couscous with the mint and the second lemon’s juice.
Top with the chicken.

Title: Lemon Garlic Salmon Risotto
Ingredients:
1¼ lb salmon fillet
1½ cup arborio rice
5 cup low-sodium chicken broth
4 cloves garlic
1 shallot
2 lemons
1 cup frozen peas
¼ cup grated Parmesan
1 tbsp butter
Steps:
Roast the seasoned salmon at 425 F for 12 minutes and flake it.
Keep the broth warm.
Cook the shallot and garlic in the butter 3 minutes; toast the rice 1 minute.
Add the broth a ladle at a time, stirring, about 18 minutes; add the peas in the last 3.
Stir in the Parmesan, lemon zest and juice.
Fold in the salmon gently.

Title: Lemon Salmon & Olive Potatoes
Ingredients:
1½ lb salmon fillet
1½ lb baby potatoes
½ cup Kalamata olives
2 lemons
3 cloves garlic
1 tsp dried oregano
1 tbsp olive oil
2 tbsp chopped dill
Salt to taste
Steps:
Heat the oven to 425 F. Halve the potatoes, toss with the oil, garlic, oregano and salt, and roast 20 minutes.
Slice one lemon into rounds.
Push the potatoes aside, add the salmon portions and olives, and lay the lemon slices on the fish.
Roast 12 minutes, until the salmon flakes.
Squeeze the second lemon over everything.
Finish with dill.

Title: Lemongrass Chicken Rice Bowls
Ingredients:
1½ lb chicken thighs
1½ cup jasmine rice
2 stalks lemongrass
3 cloves garlic
2 tbsp fish sauce
1 tbsp brown sugar
1 cucumber
2 carrots
½ cup chopped cilantro
1 lime
Steps:
Cook the rice in 2¼ cups of water, covered, 15 minutes.
Mince the tender part of the lemongrass and mix with the garlic, fish sauce and brown sugar.
Marinate the chicken 15 minutes.
Sear or grill the chicken 5 to 6 minutes per side, until 165 F; slice.
Cut the cucumber and carrots into matchsticks and toss with lime juice.
Serve the chicken over rice with the pickled vegetables and cilantro.

Title: Lemongrass Pork Rice Plates
Ingredients:
1½ lb boneless pork chops
1½ cup broken or jasmine rice
2 stalks lemongrass
3 cloves garlic
2 tbsp fish sauce
1 tbsp brown sugar
2 tomatoes
1 cucumber
4 eggs
1 lime
Steps:
Cook the rice in 2¼ cups of water, covered, 15 minutes.
Mince the lemongrass and mix with the garlic, fish sauce and sugar; marinate the pork 15 minutes.
Grill or sear the pork 4 minutes per side, until 145 F.
Fry the eggs.
Slice the tomatoes and cucumber.
Plate rice, pork, an egg and the vegetables, com tam style, with lime.

Title: Miso Butter Cod & Bok Choy
Ingredients:
1½ lb cod fillets
1½ cup short-grain rice
2 tbsp white miso
1 tbsp butter
1 tbsp mirin
1 tsp honey
1 lb baby bok choy
1 tbsp grated ginger
2 green onions
Steps:
Cook the rice in 2 cups of water, covered, 15 minutes.
Heat the broiler. Mash the miso with the softened butter, mirin and honey.
Spread it over the cod and broil 8 to 10 minutes, until browned and flaky.
Steam the halved bok choy with the ginger 3 minutes.
Plate the cod over rice with the bok choy.
Scatter with green onions.

Title: Miso Chicken & Zucchini Rice
Ingredients:
1½ lb chicken breast
1½ cup short-grain rice
2 tbsp white miso
1 tbsp mirin
1 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce
1 tsp honey
2 zucchini
1 tbsp grated ginger
1 tbsp avocado oil
Steps:
Cook the rice in 2 cups of water, covered, 15 minutes.
Whisk the miso, mirin, soy sauce, honey and ginger.
Cut the chicken into bite-size pieces and cook in the oil 6 minutes.
Add the zucchini in half-moons and cook 3 minutes.
Pour in the miso sauce with 2 tablespoons of water and toss until glazed.
Serve over rice.

Title: Orange-Ginger Chicken & Broccoli
Ingredients:
1½ lb chicken breast
1½ cup jasmine rice
1 lb broccoli florets
2 oranges
1 tbsp grated ginger
2 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce
1 tbsp honey
1 tbsp cornstarch
1 tbsp avocado oil
Steps:
Cook the rice in 2¼ cups of water, covered, 15 minutes.
Whisk the zest and juice of the oranges with the ginger, soy sauce, honey and cornstarch.
Steam the broccoli 3 minutes.
Cook the bite-size chicken in the oil 6 minutes.
Pour in the sauce and stir until thick and glossy, 1 minute; add the broccoli.
Serve over rice.

Title: Parmesan Cod & Pea Risotto
Ingredients:
1¼ lb cod fillets
1½ cup arborio rice
5 cup low-sodium chicken broth
1½ cup frozen peas
1 shallot
½ cup grated Parmesan
1 tbsp butter
1 lemon
Salt to taste
Steps:
Keep the broth warm.
Cook the shallot in the butter 2 minutes and toast the rice 1 minute.
Add the broth a ladle at a time, stirring, about 18 minutes; add the peas for the last 3 (risi e bisi style).
Meanwhile, season the cod, top with 2 tablespoons Parmesan and bake at 425 F for 12 minutes.
Stir the rest of the Parmesan and lemon zest into the risotto.
Serve the cod on top.

Title: Parmesan Trout with Pea Orzo
Ingredients:
1½ lb trout fillets
1½ cup orzo
1½ cup frozen peas
¼ cup grated Parmesan
¼ cup panko
2 cloves garlic
1 lemon
1 tbsp butter
2 tbsp chopped mint
Steps:
Heat the oven to 425 F.
Mix the Parmesan, panko and lemon zest; press onto the trout.
Bake the trout 10 minutes, until the crust is golden.
Cook the orzo in salted water 9 minutes, adding the peas for the last 2; drain.
Toss with the butter, garlic, mint and lemon juice.
Serve the trout over the orzo.

Title: Patagonian Trout with Crispy Potatoes
Ingredients:
1½ lb trout fillets
1½ lb baby potatoes
1 cup parsley
2 cloves garlic
1 tbsp red wine vinegar
2 tbsp olive oil
1 lemon
4 cup arugula
Salt to taste
Steps:
Boil the potatoes 12 minutes, drain, smash flat and roast with 1 tablespoon oil at 450 F for 20 minutes until crisp.
Chop the parsley and garlic and mix with the vinegar, the rest of the oil and salt.
Season the trout.
Sear skin-side down 3 minutes, flip and cook 1 minute more.
Toss the arugula with lemon juice.
Serve the trout with the potatoes, arugula and the parsley sauce.

Title: Picanha-Style Steak Rice Bowls
Ingredients:
1½ lb top sirloin cap
1½ cup rice
1 can black beans
1 onion
2 tomatoes
1 green bell pepper
2 tbsp red wine vinegar
1 tsp coarse salt
2 cloves garlic
1 tbsp olive oil
Steps:
Cook the rice with the garlic in 3 cups of salted water, covered, 18 minutes.
Dice the tomatoes, onion and pepper and mix with the vinegar and oil (vinagrete).
Rub the steak generously with the coarse salt.
Grill or sear 5 minutes per side for medium-rare; rest 5 minutes.
Warm and drain the black beans.
Slice the steak thin and serve over rice and beans with the vinagrete.

Title: Pork & Broccoli Garlic Rice
Ingredients:
1¼ lb pork tenderloin
1½ cup jasmine rice
1 lb broccoli florets
6 cloves garlic
3 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce
1 tbsp oyster sauce
1 tsp cornstarch
1 tbsp avocado oil
Steps:
Cook the rice with 2 garlic cloves in 2¼ cups of water, covered, 15 minutes.
Slice the pork thin and toss with 1 tablespoon soy sauce and the cornstarch.
Steam the broccoli 3 minutes.
Stir-fry the pork in the oil 4 minutes.
Add the rest of the garlic, the broccoli, the rest of the soy sauce and the oyster sauce; toss 1 minute.
Serve over the garlic rice.

Title: Pork & Jalapeño Tacos
Ingredients:
1½ lb pork tenderloin
12 corn tortillas
2 jalapeños
1 tsp chili powder
1 tsp ground cumin
1 cup shredded cabbage
½ cup chopped cilantro
½ white onion
2 limes
1 tbsp avocado oil
Steps:
Rub the pork with the chili powder, cumin and salt.
Sear in the oil, then roast at 425 F for 15 minutes, to 145 F; rest and dice.
Slice the jalapeños and char them in the hot pan 2 minutes.
Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet.
Fill the tortillas with pork, cabbage, onion, cilantro and jalapeños.
Serve with lime wedges.

Title: Pork Albondigas with Saffron Rice
Ingredients:
1¼ lb lean ground pork
1½ cup rice
1 pinch saffron
1 egg
¼ cup panko
3 cloves garlic
1 can crushed tomatoes
1 tsp smoked paprika
1 onion
2 tbsp chopped parsley
Steps:
Steep the saffron in 3 cups of hot salted water, then cook the rice in it, covered, 18 minutes.
Mix the pork with the egg, panko, half the garlic, parsley and salt; roll into 20 meatballs.
Brown the meatballs in a large skillet, 6 minutes.
Add the onion and the rest of the garlic for 3 minutes, then the tomatoes and paprika.
Simmer 12 minutes, until the meatballs are cooked through.
Serve over the saffron rice.

Title: Pork Carnitas Potato Bowls
Ingredients:
1½ lb pork tenderloin
1½ lb potatoes
1 orange
1 lime
3 cloves garlic
1 tsp ground cumin
1 tsp dried oregano
1 cup pico de gallo
½ cup chopped cilantro
1 tbsp avocado oil
Steps:
Cube the potatoes, toss with half the oil and salt, and roast at 425 F for 30 minutes.
Cut the pork into 1-inch cubes and simmer with the orange and lime juice, garlic, cumin, oregano and ½ cup water, covered, 25 minutes.
Uncover and cook until the liquid is gone.
Add the rest of the oil and fry the pork until crisp at the edges, 5 minutes.
Build bowls with potatoes and carnitas.
Top with pico de gallo and cilantro.

Title: Pork Chops with Garlic Lyonnaise Potatoes
Ingredients:
4 boneless pork chops
1½ lb Yukon Gold potatoes
2 onions
3 cloves garlic
1 tbsp butter
1 tbsp olive oil
2 tbsp chopped parsley
1 tsp dried thyme
Salt to taste
Steps:
Boil the sliced potatoes 6 minutes; drain.
Cook the sliced onions in the butter over medium heat 12 minutes, until golden.
Add the potatoes and garlic and cook 10 minutes, turning, until browned.
Season the chops with thyme and salt.
Sear the chops in the oil 4 to 5 minutes per side, until 145 F; rest.
Serve with the potatoes, finished with parsley.

Title: Pork Chops with Salsa Criolla Rice
Ingredients:
4 boneless pork chops
1½ cup rice
1 red onion
2 tomatoes
1 red bell pepper
2 tbsp red wine vinegar
1 tbsp olive oil
1 tsp dried oregano
Salt to taste
Steps:
Cook the rice in 3 cups of salted water, covered, 18 minutes.
Dice the onion, tomatoes and pepper fine and mix with the vinegar, oil, oregano and salt (salsa criolla).
Season the chops with salt.
Grill or sear 4 to 5 minutes per side, until 145 F; rest.
Fold a few spoons of the salsa into the rice.
Serve the chops with the rice and the rest of the salsa.

Title: Pork Egg Fried Rice
Ingredients:
1 lb pork tenderloin
4 cup cooked day-old rice
4 eggs
1 cup frozen peas
4 green onions
2 cloves garlic
3 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce
1 tbsp avocado oil
Steps:
Dice the pork small and season with 1 tablespoon soy sauce.
Scramble the eggs in half the oil and set aside.
Stir-fry the pork in the rest of the oil 4 minutes.
Add the garlic and peas for 1 minute.
Add the rice and press it against the hot pan 4 minutes.
Return the eggs with the rest of the soy sauce and the green onions.

Title: Pork Kofta Rice Bowls
Ingredients:
1¼ lb lean ground pork
1½ cup rice
½ onion
2 cloves garlic
1 tsp ground cumin
1 tsp sweet paprika
2 tbsp chopped parsley
1 cucumber
1 pint cherry tomatoes
½ cup plain Greek yogurt
Steps:
Cook the rice in 3 cups of salted water, covered, 18 minutes.
Grate the onion and mix it with the pork, garlic, cumin, paprika, parsley and salt.
Shape into 12 kofta and grill or sear 8 minutes, turning, until cooked through.
Dice the cucumber and halve the tomatoes.
Season the yogurt with salt and a little garlic.
Serve the kofta over rice with the salad and yogurt.

Title: Pork Meatballs with Parmesan Orzo
Ingredients:
1¼ lb lean ground pork
1½ cup orzo
1 egg
¼ cup panko
½ cup grated Parmesan
2 cloves garlic
2 cup marinara sauce
3 cup baby spinach
1 tsp Italian seasoning
Steps:
Mix the pork, egg, panko, garlic, Italian seasoning and half the Parmesan; roll into 20 meatballs.
Bake at 425 F for 15 minutes.
Simmer the meatballs in the marinara 5 minutes.
Cook the orzo in salted water 9 minutes; drain.
Toss the orzo with the spinach and the rest of the Parmesan.
Serve the meatballs and sauce over the orzo.

Title: Pork Ragu with Parmesan Polenta
Ingredients:
1½ lb pork tenderloin
1 cup quick polenta
1 can crushed tomatoes
1 onion
1 carrot
3 cloves garlic
½ cup red wine
½ cup grated Parmesan
1 tsp dried rosemary
1 tbsp olive oil
Steps:
Cut the pork into chunks, season and brown in the oil.
Add the diced onion, carrot and garlic for 5 minutes.
Add the wine, tomatoes and rosemary; cover and simmer 1 hour, until the pork shreds.
Shred the pork into the sauce.
Whisk the polenta into 4 cups of boiling salted water and cook 5 minutes; stir in the Parmesan.
Spoon the ragu over the polenta.

Title: Pork Tenderloin with Lime Potatoes
Ingredients:
1½ lb pork tenderloin
1½ lb baby potatoes
1 orange
2 limes
4 cloves garlic
1 tsp ground cumin
1 tsp dried oregano
2 tbsp olive oil
2 tbsp chopped cilantro
Steps:
Mix the orange juice, juice of 1 lime, garlic, cumin and oregano into a mojo; marinate the pork 15 minutes.
Halve the potatoes, toss with 1 tablespoon oil and salt, and roast at 425 F for 20 minutes.
Sear the pork in the rest of the oil, then add it to the potato pan.
Roast 15 to 18 minutes, until the pork reads 145 F.
Toss the potatoes with the second lime’s zest and juice and the cilantro.
Slice the pork and serve.

Title: Provencal Cod with Tomato & Olives
Ingredients:
1½ lb cod fillets
1½ cup rice
1 can diced tomatoes
⅓ cup Niçoise or Kalamata olives
1 tbsp capers
3 cloves garlic
1 shallot
1 tsp herbes de Provence
1 tbsp olive oil
2 tbsp chopped basil
Steps:
Cook the rice in 3 cups of salted water, covered, 18 minutes.
Cook the shallot and garlic in the oil 3 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, olives, capers and herbes de Provence; simmer 8 minutes.
Season the cod and lay it in the sauce.
Cover and simmer 8 minutes, until the fish flakes.
Scatter with basil and serve over rice.

Title: Salmon Couscous with Cucumber & Olives
Ingredients:
1½ lb salmon fillet
1½ cup couscous
1½ cup chicken broth
1 cucumber
⅓ cup Kalamata olives
¼ red onion
¼ cup crumbled feta
1 lemon
1 tsp dried oregano
2 tbsp chopped dill
Steps:
Pour the boiling broth over the couscous, cover 5 minutes and fluff.
Season the salmon with oregano and salt and roast at 425 F for 12 minutes.
Dice the cucumber and red onion and halve the olives.
Fold them into the couscous with the lemon juice and dill.
Flake the salmon into large pieces on top.
Finish with feta.

Title: Salmon Teriyaki with Bok Choy
Ingredients:
1½ lb salmon fillet
1½ cup short-grain rice
3 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce
2 tbsp mirin
1 tbsp honey
1 tsp grated ginger
1 lb baby bok choy
1 tbsp avocado oil
2 green onions
Steps:
Cook the rice in 2 cups of water, covered, 15 minutes.
Simmer the soy sauce, mirin, honey and ginger 2 minutes into a teriyaki glaze.
Sear the salmon skin-side down in the oil 4 minutes, flip and cook 3 minutes.
Pour the glaze over the salmon and spoon it on as it thickens, 1 minute.
Steam the halved bok choy 3 minutes.
Serve the salmon over rice with the bok choy and green onions.

Title: Salmon with Lemon Butter Orzo
Ingredients:
1½ lb salmon fillet
1½ cup orzo
2 tbsp butter
2 lemons
2 cloves garlic
3 cup baby spinach
2 tbsp chopped parsley
Salt to taste
Steps:
Season the salmon and roast at 425 F for 12 minutes.
Cook the orzo in salted water 9 minutes; drain.
Melt the butter with the garlic 1 minute.
Toss the orzo with the garlic butter, spinach, lemon zest and juice.
Finish with parsley.
Serve the salmon on the orzo with lemon wedges.

Title: Salmon with Rice, Peas & Garlic
Ingredients:
1½ lb salmon fillet
1½ cup rice
1½ cup frozen peas
4 cloves garlic
1 tbsp butter
1 lemon
1 tsp paprika
Salt to taste
Steps:
Cook the rice in 3 cups of salted water, covered, 18 minutes.
Season the salmon with paprika and salt and roast at 425 F for 12 minutes.
Cook the garlic in the butter 1 minute.
Add the peas and cook 3 minutes.
Fold the garlicky peas into the rice with lemon juice.
Serve the salmon on top.

Title: Salsa Verde Cod Tacos
Ingredients:
1½ lb cod fillets
12 corn tortillas
1 cup salsa verde
2 cup shredded cabbage
1 avocado
½ cup chopped cilantro
1 tsp chili powder
2 limes
1 tbsp avocado oil
Steps:
Season the cod with chili powder and salt.
Sear in the oil 3 to 4 minutes per side, until it flakes.
Toss the cabbage with the juice of 1 lime.
Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet.
Fill with flaked cod, cabbage, sliced avocado and cilantro.
Spoon over salsa verde and serve with lime wedges.

Title: Scallop Tomato Risotto
Ingredients:
1¼ lb sea scallops
1½ cup arborio rice
4 cup low-sodium chicken broth
1 can crushed tomatoes
1 shallot
2 cloves garlic
¼ cup grated Parmesan
1 tbsp butter
2 tbsp chopped basil
Steps:
Warm the broth with the tomatoes.
Cook the shallot and garlic in half the butter 2 minutes; toast the rice 1 minute.
Add the tomato broth a ladle at a time, stirring, about 18 minutes.
Stir in the Parmesan.
Pat the scallops very dry, season, and sear in the rest of the butter 2 minutes per side.
Serve the scallops on the risotto with basil.

Title: Seared Trout with Tomato Olive Rice
Ingredients:
1½ lb trout fillets
1½ cup rice
1 can diced tomatoes
⅓ cup green olives
1 onion
2 cloves garlic
1 tsp smoked paprika
2 cup chicken broth
1 tbsp olive oil
1 lemon
Steps:
Cook the onion and garlic in half the oil 4 minutes; stir in the paprika and rice.
Add the tomatoes and broth, cover and simmer 18 minutes.
Fold in the sliced olives.
Season the trout and sear skin-side down in the rest of the oil 3 minutes; flip for 1 minute.
Plate the trout over the rice.
Serve with lemon.

Title: Sesame-Free Tuna Poke Bowls
Ingredients:
1¼ lb sushi-grade ahi tuna
1½ cup short-grain rice
3 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce
1 tsp rice vinegar
1 tsp grated ginger
1 cucumber
1 avocado
1 mango
2 green onions
Steps:
Cook the rice in 2 cups of water, covered, 15 minutes; season with the rice vinegar.
Cube the tuna and toss with the soy sauce, ginger and green onions (no sesame oil or seeds).
Chill the tuna 10 minutes.
Dice the cucumber, avocado and mango.
Spoon the tuna over the rice.
Arrange the cucumber, avocado and mango around it.

Title: Shaking Beef Tomato Rice
Ingredients:
1¼ lb sirloin
1½ cup jasmine rice
2 tbsp tomato paste
2 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce
1 tbsp fish sauce
1 tsp sugar
4 cloves garlic
1 red onion
4 cup watercress
1 lime
Steps:
Cook the rice with the tomato paste and a pinch of salt in 2¼ cups of water, covered, 15 minutes (com do).
Cube the beef and toss with the soy sauce, fish sauce, sugar and half the garlic.
Sear the beef in a smoking-hot pan in one layer, shaking, 3 minutes (bo luc lac).
Add the red onion wedges and the rest of the garlic for 1 minute.
Toss the watercress with lime juice.
Serve the beef over the tomato rice with the watercress.

Title: Shrimp & Broccoli Couscous
Ingredients:
1½ lb shrimp
1½ cup couscous
1½ cup chicken broth
1 lb broccoli florets
3 cloves garlic
1 tsp ground cumin
1 tsp sweet paprika
1 lemon
1 tbsp olive oil
Steps:
Pour the boiling broth over the couscous, cover 5 minutes and fluff.
Steam the broccoli 3 minutes.
Toss the shrimp with the cumin, paprika and salt.
Cook the garlic in the oil 30 seconds, then the shrimp 2 minutes per side.
Add the broccoli and lemon juice and toss.
Serve over the couscous.

Title: Shrimp & Tomato Orzo
Ingredients:
1½ lb shrimp
1½ cup orzo
1 can crushed tomatoes
2 cup chicken broth
3 cloves garlic
1 tsp dried oregano
¼ cup crumbled feta
2 tbsp chopped dill
1 tbsp olive oil
Steps:
Cook the garlic in the oil 30 seconds.
Add the tomatoes, broth, oregano and orzo; cover and simmer 10 minutes, stirring once.
Nestle in the shrimp and cook 3 to 4 minutes, until pink (saganaki style).
Season with salt.
Crumble the feta over.
Finish with dill.

Title: Shrimp Enchilada Rice Bake
Ingredients:
1½ lb shrimp
1½ cup rice
1 can red enchilada sauce
1 can black beans
1 cup frozen corn
1 cup shredded reduced-fat Mexican cheese
1 tsp ground cumin
½ cup chopped cilantro
2 green onions
Steps:
Heat the oven to 400 F. Cook the rice in 3 cups of salted water, covered, 18 minutes.
Toss the shrimp with the cumin and salt.
Mix the rice with the enchilada sauce, rinsed beans and corn in a baking dish.
Nestle in the shrimp and top with the cheese.
Bake 15 minutes, until bubbling and the shrimp are pink.
Finish with cilantro and green onions.

Title: Shrimp Jalapeño Tacos
Ingredients:
1½ lb shrimp
12 corn tortillas
2 jalapeños
1 tsp chili powder
2 cup shredded cabbage
½ cup plain Greek yogurt
2 limes
½ cup chopped cilantro
1 tbsp avocado oil
Steps:
Toss the shrimp with the chili powder and salt.
Slice the jalapeños and sear them with the shrimp in the oil, 2 minutes per side.
Mix the yogurt with the juice of 1 lime and a pinch of salt.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with cabbage, shrimp and jalapeños.
Top with the lime crema and cilantro.

Title: Shrimp Pomodoro Risotto
Ingredients:
1½ lb shrimp
1½ cup arborio rice
4 cup low-sodium chicken broth
1 can crushed tomatoes
1 onion
3 cloves garlic
¼ cup grated Parmesan
1 tbsp olive oil
¼ cup chopped basil
Steps:
Warm the broth with the tomatoes.
Cook the onion and garlic in the oil 4 minutes; toast the rice 1 minute.
Add the tomato broth a ladle at a time, stirring, about 18 minutes.
Stir in the shrimp for the last 4 minutes, until pink.
Stir in the Parmesan.
Finish with basil.

Title: Soy Garlic Chicken & Edamame
Ingredients:
1½ lb chicken breast
1½ cup short-grain rice
1½ cup shelled edamame
3 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce
6 cloves garlic
1 tbsp honey
1 tbsp rice vinegar
1 tbsp cornstarch
1 tbsp avocado oil
Steps:
Cook the rice in 2 cups of water, covered, 15 minutes.
Toss the bite-size chicken with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt.
Cook the chicken in the oil 6 minutes, until golden.
Add the garlic for 30 seconds, then the soy sauce, honey and vinegar; toss until sticky.
Boil the edamame 4 minutes and add them.
Serve over rice.

Title: Soy Garlic Pork & Zucchini
Ingredients:
1¼ lb pork tenderloin
1½ cup short-grain rice
2 zucchini
3 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce
5 cloves garlic
1 tbsp honey
1 tsp gochugaru
1 tbsp avocado oil
2 green onions
Steps:
Cook the rice in 2 cups of water, covered, 15 minutes.
Slice the pork thin.
Mix the soy sauce, garlic, honey and gochugaru.
Stir-fry the pork in the oil 4 minutes.
Add the zucchini half-moons for 3 minutes, then the sauce; toss until glossy.
Serve over rice with green onions.

Title: Spanish Pork & Crispy Potatoes
Ingredients:
1½ lb pork tenderloin
1½ lb Yukon Gold potatoes
2 tsp smoked paprika
4 cloves garlic
1 tsp ground cumin
1 red bell pepper
2 tbsp olive oil
2 tbsp chopped parsley
Salt to taste
Steps:
Cube the potatoes, toss with 1 tablespoon oil, 1 teaspoon paprika and salt, and roast at 450 F for 30 minutes until crisp (patatas bravas style).
Rub the pork with the rest of the paprika, the garlic, cumin and salt (adobo).
Sear the pork in the rest of the oil, then roast with the sliced pepper 15 to 18 minutes, to 145 F.
Rest and slice the pork.
Toss the potatoes with the roasted peppers.
Finish with parsley.

Title: Spicy Beef & Zucchini Rice
Ingredients:
1¼ lb 93% lean ground beef
1½ cup short-grain rice
2 zucchini
1 tbsp gochujang
1 tbsp gochugaru
2 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce
3 cloves garlic
1 onion
2 green onions
Steps:
Cook the rice in 2 cups of water, covered, 15 minutes.
Brown the beef with the onion and garlic, 7 minutes.
Add the diced zucchini and cook 4 minutes.
Stir in the gochujang, gochugaru and soy sauce with 2 tablespoons of water.
Simmer 2 minutes until coated.
Serve over rice with green onions.

Title: Spicy Pork Bulgogi Bowls
Ingredients:
1¼ lb pork loin
1½ cup short-grain rice
2 tbsp gochujang
1 tbsp gochugaru
2 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce
1 tbsp honey
1 tbsp grated ginger
3 cloves garlic
1 onion
2 cup shredded lettuce
Steps:
Cook the rice in 2 cups of water, covered, 15 minutes.
Slice the pork very thin.
Mix the gochujang, gochugaru, soy sauce, honey, ginger and garlic (jeyuk bokkeum).
Toss the pork and sliced onion with the sauce.
Cook in a very hot skillet 6 to 7 minutes, until cooked and caramelized.
Serve over rice with lettuce.

Title: Steak au Poivre with Parmesan Mash
Ingredients:
1½ lb sirloin steaks
1½ lb Yukon Gold potatoes
1 tbsp cracked black peppercorns
½ cup beef broth
2 tbsp brandy
¼ cup light cream
¼ cup grated Parmesan
½ cup milk
1 tbsp butter
Salt to taste
Steps:
Boil the peeled potatoes 15 minutes; mash with the milk, Parmesan and salt.
Press the cracked pepper into both sides of the steaks and season with salt.
Sear in the butter 4 minutes per side for medium-rare; rest.
Deglaze the pan with the brandy, then add the broth and simmer 2 minutes.
Stir in the cream and simmer 1 minute more.
Slice the steak and serve over the mash with the pepper sauce.

Title: Tomato Beef Rice Bowls
Ingredients:
1¼ lb flank steak
1½ cup jasmine rice
4 tomatoes
1 onion
2 tbsp ketchup
2 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce
1 tsp sugar
1 tbsp cornstarch
1 tbsp avocado oil
2 green onions
Steps:
Cook the rice in 2¼ cups of water, covered, 15 minutes.
Slice the beef thin and toss with 1 tablespoon soy sauce and the cornstarch.
Sear the beef in the oil 2 minutes; set aside.
Cook the onion and tomato wedges 5 minutes, until saucy.
Add the ketchup, the rest of the soy sauce, the sugar and the beef; simmer 1 minute.
Serve over rice with green onions.

Title: Tomato Braised Pork with Rice
Ingredients:
1½ lb pork loin
1½ cup rice
1 can whole peeled tomatoes
1 onion
2 carrots
3 cloves garlic
½ cup white wine
1 tsp dried rosemary
1 tbsp olive oil
Steps:
Cut the pork into 1½-inch chunks, season and brown in the oil.
Add the onion, carrots and garlic for 5 minutes.
Add the wine, crushed tomatoes and rosemary.
Cover and braise gently 1 hour, until tender (spezzatino).
Cook the rice in 3 cups of salted water, covered, 18 minutes.
Serve the pork and sauce over the rice.

Title: Tomato Coconut Cod Stew
Ingredients:
1½ lb cod fillets
1½ cup rice
1 can light coconut milk
1 can diced tomatoes
1 onion
1 red bell pepper
3 cloves garlic
1 lime
1 tsp sweet paprika
¼ cup chopped cilantro
Steps:
Cook the rice in 3 cups of salted water, covered, 18 minutes.
Toss the cod chunks with lime juice and salt.
Cook the onion, pepper and garlic 5 minutes; add the paprika.
Add the tomatoes and coconut milk and simmer 8 minutes.
Add the cod and simmer 6 minutes, until it flakes.
Finish with cilantro and serve over rice.

Title: Tomato Saffron Cod with Rice
Ingredients:
1½ lb cod fillets
1½ cup rice
1 pinch saffron
1 can diced tomatoes
1 onion
3 cloves garlic
1 tsp smoked paprika
2 cup fish or chicken broth
1 tbsp olive oil
2 tbsp chopped parsley
Steps:
Steep the saffron in the warm broth.
Cook the onion and garlic in the oil 4 minutes; add the paprika and rice.
Add the tomatoes and saffron broth, cover and simmer 15 minutes.
Lay the seasoned cod on the rice, cover and cook 8 minutes more, until the fish flakes.
Rest 3 minutes.
Finish with parsley.

Title: Turkey-Free Beef Moussaka Bowls
Ingredients:
1¼ lb 93% lean ground beef
1 cup rice
1 eggplant
1 onion
2 cloves garlic
1 can crushed tomatoes
1 tsp ground cinnamon
1 tsp dried oregano
¾ cup plain Greek yogurt
¼ cup grated Parmesan
Steps:
Cook the rice in 2 cups of salted water, covered, 18 minutes.
Cube the eggplant and roast at 425 F for 20 minutes, until soft and browned.
Brown the beef with the onion and garlic, 8 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, cinnamon and oregano and simmer 10 minutes; fold in the eggplant.
Mix the yogurt with the Parmesan for a quick béchamel-style topping.
Serve the beef over rice topped with the yogurt sauce.

Title: Turmeric Fish with Dill Rice
Ingredients:
1½ lb cod or halibut fillets
1½ cup jasmine rice
1 tbsp ground turmeric
2 tbsp fish sauce
1 tbsp grated ginger
1 cup chopped dill
4 green onions
1 lime
¼ cup chopped peanuts
1 tbsp avocado oil
Steps:
Cook the rice in 2¼ cups of water, covered, 15 minutes.
Cut the fish into chunks and toss with the turmeric, fish sauce and ginger; rest 10 minutes.
Sear the fish in the oil 3 minutes per side, until golden.
Add the dill and green onions in long pieces and toss 30 seconds until just wilted (cha ca la vong).
Fold some of the dill into the rice.
Serve the fish over the rice with lime and peanuts.
